ai_levant_stamped_electrum.title: Lumps With a Lion
ai_levant_stamped_electrum.description: Your goldsmiths propose stamping electrum from the Pactolus with a lion's head, so merchants trust the weight without a scale.

options.label: Keep weighing metal by the scale

ai_levant_cimmerian_riders.title: Riders From the North
ai_levant_cimmerian_riders.description: Cimmerian horsemen pour across the Halys and ride toward Gordion, burning villages as they come.

options.label: Pay the riders to pass by

ai_levant_erebuni_captives.title: A Fortress at Erebuni
ai_levant_erebuni_captives.description: You have raised a new fortress on the Ararat plain, and thousands of captives from your campaigns await your word.

options.label: Settle the captives around the fortress

ai_levant_median_army_reform.title: Spears, Bows and Horses
ai_levant_median_army_reform.description: Your levies fight as mixed clan bands. Your officers urge you to split them into separate units of spearmen, archers and cavalry before marching on Assyria.

ai_levant_marib_sluices.title: The Great Dam Cracks
ai_levant_marib_sluices.description: Floods in the Wadi Dhana have scoured the dam's sluices. Without repair, the fields of the two oases will go dry.

options.label: Rebuild the sluices in cut stone
Patch it with earth and hope

ai_levant_tribute_to_assyria.title: The Assyrian Demand
ai_levant_tribute_to_assyria.description: Tiglath-Pileser's army stands in Syria, and his envoys demand camels and tribute from the queen of the Arabs.

ai_levant_roman_annexation.title: Rome Takes Arabia
ai_levant_roman_annexation.description: Trajan has annexed the Nabataean kingdom, and a Roman detachment marches south to garrison Hegra and its caravan road.

options.label: Open the gates to the garrison

ai_levant_asiatic_vespers.title: Letters to Every City
ai_levant_asiatic_vespers.description: Your armies hold Asia. Your advisors propose secret orders to the cities to fall on every Roman and Italian on the same day.

options.label: Seize their goods, spare their lives

ai_westafrica_looted_terracottas.title: Terracottas on Foreign Markets
ai_westafrica_looted_terracottas.description: Diggers are stripping ancient Nok sites at night, and the clay heads turn up in European auction houses. Your village elders demand action.

options.label: Post armed guards at the sites

ai_westafrica_gsm_licences.title: The Mobile Phone Licences
ai_westafrica_gsm_licences.description: Telecom giants bid for the right to build mobile networks, Ayo. A high price fills the treasury, but cheap licences could put a phone in every market.

options.label: Grant cheap licences for wide coverage

ai_westafrica_home_video_boom.title: The Home Video Boom
ai_westafrica_home_video_boom.description: Cheap cameras and video cassettes have turned Ile-Ife's actors into stars, but pirated copies sell faster than the originals.

options.label: Tax the trade and look away

ai_westafrica_offshore_oil_find.title: Oil Beneath the Sea
ai_westafrica_offshore_oil_find.description: Drillers strike a large oil field off the coast, and Bono Manso fills with consultants. How fast you pump will shape a generation.

options.label: Pass a law to save revenues

ai_westafrica_cobalt_rush.title: The Cobalt Rush
ai_westafrica_cobalt_rush.description: The world's phones and batteries need cobalt, and diggers with shovels crowd the pits near Kabongo. Foreign companies offer to take over.

ai_westafrica_diamond_certification.title: Certifying the Diamonds
ai_westafrica_diamond_certification.description: A new international scheme demands that every rough diamond carry a certificate of origin. Lunda diggers have long sold theirs across the border.

ai_westafrica_ebola_outbreak.title: Ebola Returns
ai_westafrica_ebola_outbreak.description: Ebola breaks out in the eastern provinces, Lueji. A new vaccine exists, but health teams face distrust and armed groups on the roads.

options.label: Seal the roads out of the region

ai_westafrica_ceasefire_demobilization.title: After the Ceasefire
ai_westafrica_ceasefire_demobilization.description: The long civil war is over, Ngola Kiluanje, and tens of thousands of rebel fighters wait in camps. Each one needs a future.

ai_europe_siege_of_candia.title: The Long Siege
ai_europe_siege_of_candia.description: Ottoman armies have landed on Crete and dug trenches before the great walled port near Knossos. Engineers beg for powder and stone; merchants beg for peace.

ai_europe_iron_mountain_union.title: The Iron Mountain Guilds
ai_europe_iron_mountain_union.description: The quarrelling ironmasters of the Styrian ore mountain near Noreia are going bankrupt. Your treasurers propose merging them into one crown-backed company.

ai_europe_bursting_bottles.title: Wine That Bursts
ai_europe_bursting_bottles.description: Cellars around Durocortorum now sell wine that foams in the glass, but many bottles explode in the heat. Glassmakers promise thicker bottles at a high price.

ai_europe_portuguese_succession.title: A Crown Without Heir
ai_europe_portuguese_succession.description: The old king has died childless, and the King of Spain claims the throne with gold and soldiers. A royal bastard rallies the commons against him.

ai_europe_allied_fleet_kerch.title: Fleets in the Strait
ai_europe_allied_fleet_kerch.description: British and French warships are heading for the strait at Panticapaeum to cut supplies to the besieged Crimean fortress. The garrison cannot hold everything.

ai_europe_dutch_timber_trade.title: Dutch Ships for Timber
ai_europe_dutch_timber_trade.description: Dutch skippers crowd the fjords of the Rygir, paying well for sawn planks and masts. Water-powered sawmills spread, and the forests thin quickly.

options.label: License the sawmills and tax them
Reserve the oaks for your navy

ai_europe_mountain_serf_revolt.title: The Miners Rise
ai_europe_mountain_serf_revolt.description: Serfs of the gold-mining mountains of Dacia have risen against their lords, burning manors and demanding freedom. The nobles demand troops; the peasants demand justice.

ai_europe_foreign_excavator.title: A Rich Man Digs
ai_europe_foreign_excavator.description: A wealthy German merchant asks to dig the shaft graves at Mycenae, promising golden treasures. Your archaeologists fear he will strip the site and boast abroad.

ai_japan_buddha_from_baekje.title: A Gilded Buddha Arrives
ai_japan_buddha_from_baekje.description: Envoys from Baekje present a gilded statue and sutras, urging you to honor the foreign Buddha. Clans loyal to the old kami warn of divine anger.

options.label: Build temples and welcome the monks
Cast the statue into the canal

ai_japan_land_census_reform.title: All Land to the Throne
ai_japan_land_census_reform.description: Your ministers propose a Chinese-style reform: every rice field registered, owned by the throne and allotted by census. The great clans would lose their private estates.

options.label: Order the census and redistribute fields

ai_japan_envoys_to_tang.title: Ships to the Tang Court
ai_japan_envoys_to_tang.description: Scholars and monks beg passage to Chang'an to study law, writing and medicine. The crossing is perilous and many ships never return.

ai_japan_ambush_at_the_river.title: Ambush on the Kitakami
ai_japan_ambush_at_the_river.description: An imperial army fords the Kitakami River to burn your villages. Your scouts say part of it can be trapped against the water.

ai_japan_palisade_of_isawa.title: The Shogun Approaches
ai_japan_palisade_of_isawa.description: A new general of the court marches north with a larger army than any before. Isawa's elders debate walls or a bargain.

ai_japan_gold_of_mutsu.title: Gold in the Northern Streams
ai_japan_gold_of_mutsu.description: Gold has been found in the rivers of your lands, and the court wants it for a great bronze Buddha. Its agents offer rich trade goods.

options.label: Sell gold and horses to the court
Hide the streams and keep your herds

ai_japan_mongol_fleet.title: Mongol Sails at Hakata
ai_japan_mongol_fleet.description: The Mongol khan, having demanded submission, lands an army at Hakata Bay. Even after a storm scatters it, he will surely return.

options.label: Build a stone wall along the bay

ai_japan_kangi_famine.title: The Cold Summer
ai_japan_kangi_famine.description: A cold, wet summer ruins the rice harvest and starving families sell themselves into servitude. Your granaries cannot feed everyone.

ai_pacific_kuk_world_heritage.title: Ancient Fields Win Recognition
ai_pacific_kuk_world_heritage.description: The old drainage ditches of Kuk swamp are named a World Heritage site. Visitors and scholars want the ground protected, but local families still plant gardens there.

ai_pacific_mine_tailings_river.title: Poison in the River
ai_pacific_mine_tailings_river.description: Waste from a great copper mine has choked the river downstream, and villagers are suing the company in a foreign court. The mine pays much of your budget.

options.label: Keep the mine running at full output
Force a settlement and cleanup fund

ai_pacific_nan_madol_in_danger.title: Ruins in Danger
ai_pacific_nan_madol_in_danger.description: The stone islets of Nan Madol are listed as World Heritage in danger. Mangroves clog the canals and the basalt walls are slipping into the sea.

options.label: Fund foreign experts to clear the canals
Leave the site to the local chiefs

ai_pacific_compact_renegotiation.title: The Compact Comes Due
ai_pacific_compact_renegotiation.description: The free association compact with the United States is up for renewal. Washington offers years of grants, but wants close oversight of how every dollar is spent.

ai_pacific_marine_relocation.title: The Marines Are Coming
ai_pacific_marine_relocation.description: Thousands of Marines will move to the island from Okinawa. The base brings money and jobs, but it needs ancestral land and old village sites.

options.label: Demand the ancestral lands back first

ai_pacific_typhoon_strikes_guam.title: The Typhoon Passes Over
ai_pacific_typhoon_strikes_guam.description: A super typhoon has torn through the island, snapping power poles and cutting water to most homes. Crews can patch the old grid fast or rebuild it stronger.

options.label: Patch everything as fast as possible

ai_pacific_parliament_seized.title: Gunmen in Parliament
ai_pacific_parliament_seized.description: Armed men hold the prime minister and his cabinet hostage inside parliament. The chiefs are divided, and the army waits to see which way you lean.

options.label: Demand a return to the constitution

ai_pacific_rising_tide_mussau.title: The Sea Comes Inland
ai_pacific_rising_tide_mussau.description: King tides now wash over the low shores where the first potters once lived, salting the gardens and wells. Elders refuse to leave their ancestors behind.

options.label: Build a seawall along the shore
Move the village to higher ground

ai_americas_pyramid_of_the_sun.title: Raising the Pyramid
ai_americas_pyramid_of_the_sun.description: Your architects propose piling millions of baskets of earth and stone into a vast pyramid along the great avenue, a work that would take a generation of labor.

options.label: Build modestly and keep farmers in fields

ai_americas_entrada_at_mutal.title: The Arrival at Mutal
ai_americas_entrada_at_mutal.description: Your general Siyaj K'ak' stands ready to march on the Maya city of Mutal. Its king could be replaced by a lord loyal to you.

options.label: Send the warriors and crown your own
Offer obsidian trade and marriage instead

ai_americas_conquest_slabs.title: Stones of Conquest
ai_americas_conquest_slabs.description: Your priests wish to carve the names of subdued valley towns onto slabs set in a new building on the mountaintop, for all visitors to read.

options.label: Honor the towns as allies instead

ai_americas_marked_adobe.title: Bricks by the Million
ai_americas_marked_adobe.description: Each lineage owes adobe bricks for the great huaca and stamps them with its own mark. Some lineages now fall short of their quota.

options.label: Accept copper ornaments instead of bricks

ai_americas_obsidian_from_the_west.title: Obsidian from the West
ai_americas_obsidian_from_the_west.description: Traders bring word of black glass from mountains far to the west. Fetching it means long journeys, but it would grace your burial mounds.

options.label: Trade only in Great Lakes copper

ai_americas_gila_canals.title: Digging from the Gila
ai_americas_gila_canals.description: Elders propose a longer canal from the Gila River to water new fields, but digging it would pull hands from the harvest.

ai_americas_raised_fields.title: Fields Above the Frost
ai_americas_raised_fields.description: Farmers near the lake show how raised beds between water channels shield crops from frost. Building them widely would need labor gangs from every ayllu.

options.label: Order raised fields across the shore

ai_americas_mounds_above_flood.title: Mounds Above the Flood
ai_americas_mounds_above_flood.description: The rainy season floods ever more of the island. Your people could raise great earthen mounds for homes and burials, but the work is endless.

options.label: Raise new mounds for the villages

ai_westafrica_portuguese_envoys_kabasa.title: Envoys From Portugal
ai_westafrica_portuguese_envoys_kabasa.description: Paulo Dias de Novais has reached your court with priests and gifts, asking for trade and the right to preach. Your rival Kongo already deals with Lisbon.

options.label: Welcome them and seek their guns

ai_westafrica_imbangala_war_bands.title: The Imbangala Offer
ai_westafrica_imbangala_war_bands.description: Fierce Imbangala war bands camp near Kabasa, offering their spears to whoever pays most. The Portuguese at Luanda are bidding too.

ai_westafrica_kasanje_gun_caravan.title: Guns From Kasanje
ai_westafrica_kasanje_gun_caravan.description: Caravans from Kasanje reach Musumba bearing muskets, cloth and gunpowder. They want ivory and captives in return, and your tributary chiefs want a share.

ai_westafrica_nyamwezi_traders_arrive.title: Traders From the East
ai_westafrica_nyamwezi_traders_arrive.description: Nyamwezi caravans led by men like Msiri push into Luba lands with guns, hungry for copper and ivory. Some already meddle in Katanga's chiefdoms.

ai_westafrica_asante_tribute_demand.title: Asante Demands Tribute
ai_westafrica_asante_tribute_demand.description: The rising Asante under Opoku Ware demand that Bono Manso submit and pay tribute in gold. Refusal means war with the strongest army in the forest.

ai_westafrica_gold_for_muskets.title: Gold for Muskets
ai_westafrica_gold_for_muskets.description: Dyula merchants and coastal brokers say the Dutch at Elmina now sell muskets freely. Your gold fields could buy many, if you send the gold south.

ai_westafrica_oyo_refugees_modakeke.title: Refugees From Oyo
ai_westafrica_oyo_refugees_modakeke.description: With Old Oyo collapsing, thousands of Oyo refugees seek shelter beside Ile-Ife. They bring hands and warriors, but your people resent the strangers.

options.label: Settle them in their own quarter

ai_westafrica_zazzau_slave_raids.title: Raiders From Zazzau
ai_westafrica_zazzau_slave_raids.description: After the Sokoto jihad, horsemen of the new Zazzau emirate raid south for captives. They offer peace if your villages pay yearly tribute.

ai_monsoon_eel_channels.title: Channels in the Lava
ai_monsoon_eel_channels.description: The lava flows near Budj Bim hold wetlands full of short-finned eels. Your people could cut stone channels and weirs to trap them, but the work is long.

options.label: Cut new channels through the basalt
Fish the wetlands as your mothers did

ai_monsoon_smoked_eel_trade.title: Smoke in the Trees
ai_monsoon_smoked_eel_trade.description: The autumn run fills every trap, more than the clans can eat. Smoked in hollow trees, the eels could travel far to neighbours who want them.

options.label: Smoke the surplus and trade it away
Feast the clans and gather them close

ai_monsoon_rising_sea.title: The Sea Comes Inland
ai_monsoon_rising_sea.description: The warm age has raised the sea above any memory, and salt water creeps over the low plains where your camps once stood.

options.label: Move the camps to higher ground
Stay and harvest the new mangrove shore

ai_monsoon_rice_from_north.title: Rice From the North
ai_monsoon_rice_from_north.description: Strangers coming down the rivers plant rice in flooded fields and raise pigs. Your foragers watch them clear the forest your people have always hunted.

options.label: Learn their fields and their rice
Trade game and shells for their grain
Drive them from your hunting grounds

ai_monsoon_outrigger_landing.title: Canoes From the North
ai_monsoon_outrigger_landing.description: Outrigger canoes arrive on the Luzon shore carrying families, red-slipped pots and a new tongue. They ask to settle beside your fishing camps.

options.label: Welcome them and share the bay
Let them land only to trade

ai_monsoon_shell_middens.title: Mountains of Shells
ai_monsoon_shell_middens.description: Your coastal camps have eaten clams for generations, and the shell heaps now rise like hills. The elders bury the dead within them, but the beds grow thin.

options.label: Move upriver to new shellfish beds
Stay by the ancestors and hunt more

ai_monsoon_polished_adzes.title: The Polished Adze
ai_monsoon_polished_adzes.description: Craftsmen at Phong Chau grind stone adzes smooth and carve fine rings of soft stone. Villages up and down the river want them.

options.label: Send the best stone to the toolmakers
Carve rings and ornaments for trade

ai_monsoon_sumatran_foragers.title: Pebble Tools by the Strait
ai_monsoon_sumatran_foragers.description: Your bands on the Sumatran coast live on shellfish and forest game, chipping river pebbles into tools. Some urge moving inland where the forest is richer.

options.label: Follow the rivers into the forest
Hold the coast and its shell beds

ai_steppe_botai_horse_milk.title: Mares at the Pen
ai_steppe_botai_horse_milk.description: Your hunters have penned wild horses beside their pit houses, and some women now milk the mares into clay pots.

options.label: Keep the herds penned for milk and meat
Break a few to carry riders

ai_steppe_kurgan_wagons.title: Mounds and Wagons
ai_steppe_kurgan_wagons.description: Your herders roll heavy ox wagons across the open steppe and heap great earth mounds over their chiefs.

options.label: Raise a grand kurgan for the dead chief
Send the wagons farther with the herds

ai_steppe_murghab_canals.title: Water from the Murghab
ai_steppe_murghab_canals.description: The river delta feeding your walled town is shifting, and the canals that water its fields silt up each season.

options.label: Dig new canals with every hand
Move fields to the new channel

ai_steppe_sarazm_turquoise.title: Turquoise and Copper
ai_steppe_sarazm_turquoise.description: Your village on the Zeravshan sits between the mountain mines and the farmers of the south, who pay well for turquoise and copper.

options.label: Work the mines for southern traders
Trade only for goods you need

ai_steppe_delta_fishers.title: Fishers of the Delta
ai_steppe_delta_fishers.description: Your people live by fishing and hunting in the reed marshes of the Amu Darya delta, while neighbors to the south sow grain.

options.label: Learn to sow grain like the south
Keep to the reeds and the nets

ai_steppe_altai_newcomers.title: Strangers with Cattle
ai_steppe_altai_newcomers.description: Herders from the far west have crossed into the Altai valleys with cattle, sheep and copper tools, settling the pastures your hunters roam.

options.label: Welcome them and learn their herding
Drive them from the best valleys

ai_steppe_spoked_chariots.title: Furnaces and Chariots
ai_steppe_spoked_chariots.description: Every house in your ringed fort has its own copper furnace, and your smiths now build light carts on spoked wheels.

options.label: Trade the copper to distant herders

ai_steppe_millet_highlands.title: Millet on the Plateau
ai_steppe_millet_highlands.description: Farmers from the eastern lowlands have brought millet up into the high river valleys, where your people have only hunted and gathered.

options.label: Clear terraces for the new crop
Trade game and hides for their grain

ai_mesopotamia_looters_at_the_tell.title: Looters at the Tell
ai_mesopotamia_looters_at_the_tell.description: War has emptied the countryside, and night diggers now riddle the ancient palace mound with pits, selling what they find to dealers abroad.

options.label: Send armed guards to the ruins
Tax the dealers and look away

ai_mesopotamia_guard_the_museum.title: Mobs at the Museum
ai_mesopotamia_guard_the_museum.description: The old regime has fallen and crowds roam the streets. Looters gather at the museum doors while others eye the oil ministry. You can protect only one.

ai_mesopotamia_oil_for_food.title: Oil for Food
ai_mesopotamia_oil_for_food.description: Sanctions have hollowed out your markets and hospitals. Foreign powers offer to let you sell oil again, but only under their inspectors and their accounts.

ai_mesopotamia_centrifuge_bargain.title: The Centrifuge Bargain
ai_mesopotamia_centrifuge_bargain.description: After years of sanctions, the great powers offer relief if you dismantle most of your enrichment halls and open them to inspectors.

options.label: Sign the deal and lift sanctions

ai_mesopotamia_fort_and_reclamation.title: Towers Before the Fort
ai_mesopotamia_fort_and_reclamation.description: The old fort is named a world heritage site, yet developers want to fill the shallow sea before it with land for towers and marinas.

options.label: Protect the coastline around the fort

ai_mesopotamia_island_banking_hub.title: An Island of Banks
ai_mesopotamia_island_banking_hub.description: Your oil wells are running thin. Bankers propose turning the island into the Gulf's financial harbor, with light rules and foreign capital pouring in.

options.label: Open the gates to foreign capital
Train local engineers and diversify slowly

ai_mesopotamia_euphrates_drought.title: The River Runs Low
ai_mesopotamia_euphrates_drought.description: A third dry year withers the Euphrates valley, and dams upstream hold back what rain there was. Farmers are abandoning their fields for the cities.

options.label: Fund deep wells and feed subsidies
Let the farmers move to the cities

ai_mesopotamia_reflood_the_marshes.title: Breaking the Dikes
ai_mesopotamia_reflood_the_marshes.description: The southern marshes were drained a decade ago and their people scattered. Now villagers are tearing open the dikes, asking you to let the water return.

options.label: Keep the drained land for farms and oil

ai_monsoon_bronze_drums.title: Drums of Bronze
ai_monsoon_bronze_drums.description: Your smiths at Phong Chau can cast great bronze drums, their faces ringed with birds and boatmen, to be beaten at rites and buried with chiefs.

options.label: Melt copper stores for sacred drums

ai_monsoon_kaundinya_marriage.title: The Brahmin from the Sea
ai_monsoon_kaundinya_marriage.description: A foreign Brahmin named Kaundinya has landed with a ship and armed men. He offers to wed you and rule beside you, bringing Indian rites and letters.

options.label: Marry him and adopt his rites
Drive his ship back to sea

ai_monsoon_lam_ap_revolt.title: Revolt Against Han
ai_monsoon_lam_ap_revolt.description: In Xianglin, at the empire's southern edge, Khu Lien urges your people to kill the Han magistrate and proclaim a kingdom of their own.

options.label: Pay tribute and bide your time

ai_monsoon_pyu_monks.title: Monks at the Gate
ai_monsoon_pyu_monks.description: Buddhist monks arrive at Sri Ksetra carrying Pali texts and ask for land to build monasteries within your great brick walls.

options.label: Keep faith with the old spirits

ai_monsoon_gomati_canal.title: The Gomati Canal
ai_monsoon_gomati_canal.description: Your engineers propose digging a canal over eleven kilometers long to tame the floods near the coast, a work of thousands of laborers in twenty-one days.

options.label: Dig it and gift cows to Brahmins
Leave the river to the monsoon

ai_monsoon_yupa_pillars.title: Pillars of Sacrifice
ai_monsoon_yupa_pillars.description: Brahmins at Muara Kaman ask you to raise stone yupa posts recording your gift of twenty thousand cows, proclaiming your lineage in Sanskrit.

options.label: Give the cows and raise the stones

ai_monsoon_wu_envoys.title: Envoys from Wu
ai_monsoon_wu_envoys.description: Chinese envoys Kang Tai and Zhu Ying reach your capital, recording your customs and urging your people to dress in the manner of their court.

ai_levant_short_alphabet.title: A Short Alphabet
ai_levant_short_alphabet.description: Scribes in Ugarit press a cuneiform alphabet of only thirty signs into clay, far easier to learn than the Akkadian your diplomats still use.

options.label: Teach the new script to merchants
Keep Akkadian for all royal business

ai_levant_assyrian_merchant_quarter.title: Merchants from Assur
ai_levant_assyrian_merchant_quarter.description: Donkey caravans from Assur bring tin and textiles to the merchant quarter below your mound, asking for fixed tolls and royal protection.

options.label: Grant a charter for a share of goods

ai_levant_fall_of_hattusa.title: The Fall of Hattusa
ai_levant_fall_of_hattusa.description: Your troops have taken Hattusa by night after a long siege. It could become a second seat of power, or a warning to every rival.

options.label: Raze it and curse the ground

ai_levant_ships_off_the_coast.title: Ships off the Coast
ai_levant_ships_off_the_coast.description: Enemy ships burn your coastal villages while your fleet and troops serve the Hittite king far away in Lukka.

options.label: Recall the army from Hittite service

ai_levant_copper_for_the_gulf.title: Copper for the Gulf
ai_levant_copper_for_the_gulf.description: Ships from the cities of Mesopotamia wait at your harbors for smelted copper, but the mountain furnaces are devouring scrub and timber.

options.label: Limit smelting to spare the wood

ai_levant_taming_wadi_floods.title: Taming the Wadi Floods
ai_levant_taming_wadi_floods.description: Seasonal floods roar down the wadi. Your engineers propose stone sluices and earthen dams to spread the water over the fields of Maryab.

options.label: Build the dams with conscripted labor
Let the clans keep their own channels

ai_levant_fortress_on_the_rock.title: A Fortress on the Rock
ai_levant_fortress_on_the_rock.description: Assyrian armies have marched to the shores of Lake Van. Your builders could raise massive limestone walls on the great rock of Tushpa.

ai_levant_gold_in_the_rivers.title: Gold in the Rivers
ai_levant_gold_in_the_rivers.description: Mountain streams carry gold dust, which your people catch on sheepskins laid in the current. The bronze smiths want the same hands at their forges.

ai_mesopotamia_mari_canal.title: The Canal of Mari
ai_mesopotamia_mari_canal.description: Your builders raise Mari beside the Euphrates and propose a long canal to bring river boats to its gates and water to its fields.

options.label: Dig the canal with every hand
Trust the river as it flows

ai_mesopotamia_river_tolls.title: Tolls on the Euphrates
ai_mesopotamia_river_tolls.description: Boats laden with timber and stone pass your people on their way to the cities of the south. Your elders ask whether to tax them.

options.label: Take a share of every cargo
Let them pass and win friends

ai_mesopotamia_kingship_kish.title: Kingship Descends to Kish
ai_mesopotamia_kingship_kish.description: The scribes say that after the flood, kingship came down from heaven to Kish. Other cities now look to your lugal as judge in their quarrels.

options.label: Judge the quarrels of the cities
Guard Kish and ignore its rivals

ai_mesopotamia_standing_army.title: Men Who Eat Daily
ai_mesopotamia_standing_army.description: Your inscriptions boast of thousands of soldiers who eat bread before you every day. Feeding them drains the granaries of Akkad.

options.label: Send half home to the fields

ai_mesopotamia_proto_elamite_tablets.title: Signs on Clay
ai_mesopotamia_proto_elamite_tablets.description: Your scribes begin marking clay tablets with their own signs, unlike those of the lowland cities, to count grain, sheep and workers.

options.label: Train scribes in our own signs
Borrow the lowland way of writing

ai_mesopotamia_highland_copper.title: Copper of the Highlands
ai_mesopotamia_highland_copper.description: Traders from the plains climb to Anshan seeking copper and fine stone from your mountains, offering grain and cloth in return.

options.label: Open the mines to the traders
Keep the metal for our own smiths

ai_mesopotamia_burial_mounds.title: Fields of Mounds
ai_mesopotamia_burial_mounds.description: Your people raise thousands of stone burial mounds across the island. The work honors the dead but takes men from the boats and palms.

options.label: Raise great mounds for the elders

ai_mesopotamia_ships_of_magan.title: Ships from Magan
ai_mesopotamia_ships_of_magan.description: Boats bring copper from Magan and carnelian from Meluhha to your harbor, bound for the quays of Akkad. Merchants ask you to guard the sea lanes.

options.label: Arm boats to guard the gulf
Tax the cargo and stay neutral

ai_monsoon_lac_lords_tribute.title: The Lac Lords' Tribute
ai_monsoon_lac_lords_tribute.description: The Lac lords who govern the flooded rice fields of the Red River valley question why their harvest should feed your court at all.

options.label: Demand a fixed share of every harvest
Grant them bronze gifts for their loyalty

ai_monsoon_sandstone_molds.title: Molds of Sandstone
ai_monsoon_sandstone_molds.description: Casters at Phong Chau now pour bronze axes and spearheads into reusable stone molds, but the copper and tin they need must come from distant hills.

options.label: Send porters to the upland mines

ai_monsoon_mekong_copper_hills.title: Copper by the Mekong
ai_monsoon_mekong_copper_hills.description: Villagers report green-stained rock in the hills near the Mekong, where outsiders already dig and smelt copper in small clay furnaces.

options.label: Trade rice and salt for ingots

ai_monsoon_green_stone_north.title: Green Stone from the North
ai_monsoon_green_stone_north.description: Outrigger canoes arrive from the islands to the north carrying polished green nephrite, and their crews want a place to settle on your shore.

options.label: Trade at the beach, then send them on

ai_monsoon_burial_jars.title: Jars for the Dead
ai_monsoon_burial_jars.description: Coastal families now bury their dead in great clay jars on the dunes, and the potters demand more firewood and labor than the villages can spare.

options.label: Fund the potters from your stores

ai_monsoon_failed_rains.title: The Rains Fail
ai_monsoon_failed_rains.description: The monsoon has barely touched the dry plains this year, and the millet in the fields is withering before it can head.

ai_monsoon_mounds_above_flood.title: Mounds Above the Flood
ai_monsoon_mounds_above_flood.description: Each monsoon the lower Mekong swells across the plain, and elders argue whether to raise the villages on earthen mounds or move to higher ground.

options.label: Raise mounds and ring them with ditches
Move the villages to the hills

ai_maghreb_oil_strike.title: Oil Beneath the Sand
ai_maghreb_oil_strike.description: Foreign drillers strike oil deep in your desert. Concessions could make you rich overnight, but the companies demand generous terms.

ai_maghreb_italian_landing.title: Italian Warships Offshore
ai_maghreb_italian_landing.description: An Italian fleet lands troops on the coast and claims the land as a colony. The tribes of the Green Mountain look to you.

options.label: Arm the tribes for guerrilla war

ai_maghreb_night_uprising.title: Revolt in the Mountains
ai_maghreb_night_uprising.description: Nationalist fighters strike across the country in a single night, and the colonial army answers with mass arrests.

ai_maghreb_rif_republic.title: Republic of the Rif
ai_maghreb_rif_republic.description: Rif tribesmen rout a Spanish army at Annual, and their leaders talk of a republic of their own in the mountains.

ai_maghreb_iron_railway.title: Iron Mountain Railway
ai_maghreb_iron_railway.description: A foreign consortium opens an iron mine in the northern desert and a long railway to the sea. They want a long lease and few taxes.

options.label: Lease the mine to the consortium

ai_maghreb_sahel_drought.title: The Rains Fail
ai_maghreb_sahel_drought.description: Years of drought kill the herds and drive the nomads into the towns, where markets and wells are overwhelmed.

ai_maghreb_mosque_rebuilt.title: Rebuilding the Great Mosque
ai_maghreb_mosque_rebuilt.description: Masons propose raising a new mud mosque on the ruins of the old one, while colonial officials eye the gathering crowds warily.

ai_maghreb_pickup_war.title: The Pickup Truck War
ai_maghreb_pickup_war.description: Your fighters in light trucks with mounted guns face a northern neighbor's armored columns across the desert.

ai_korea_dolmen_capstone.title: The Great Capstone
ai_korea_dolmen_capstone.description: Your elders want a dolmen for the late chieftain, crowned with a capstone so heavy that hundreds must haul it on log rollers.

options.label: Quarry and haul the giant stone
Bury him in a modest stone cist

ai_korea_flooded_paddies.title: Water for the Rice
ai_korea_flooded_paddies.description: Farmers near Ungjin have learned to grow rice in flooded, banked fields, but the channels and dikes need the labor of every household.

options.label: Order the digging of paddies and channels
Keep to the old millet fields

ai_korea_lute_daggers.title: The Lute-Shaped Daggers
ai_korea_lute_daggers.description: Casters in Wanggeom-seong pour bronze into stone molds, making the lute-shaped daggers prized from Liaodong to the southern valleys.

options.label: Send them as gifts to rival chiefs

ai_korea_village_moat.title: Ditch and Palisade
ai_korea_village_moat.description: Raids on granaries grow bolder each harvest, and the people of Buyeo ask for a deep ditch and a wooden palisade around the village.

options.label: Dig the ditch and raise the stakes
Flee to the hilltop when raiders come

ai_korea_heavenly_rite.title: Son of Heaven
ai_korea_heavenly_rite.description: Shamans proclaim that your line descends from the sky, and they demand a great rite of bronze mirrors, bells and offerings to prove it.

ai_korea_northern_horses.title: Horses from the North
ai_korea_northern_horses.description: Herders from the northern grasslands arrive with sturdy horses and ask for grain, though your scouts warn they also eye your fields.

options.label: Turn them back at the river

ai_korea_tin_shortage.title: The Missing Tin
ai_korea_tin_shortage.description: Your bronze casters have copper but almost no tin, and the nearest sources lie far to the north beyond hostile chiefdoms.

options.label: Melt down old ornaments and blades

ai_korea_crowded_longhouses.title: Crowded Longhouses
ai_korea_crowded_longhouses.description: Your great longhouses now shelter several families each, and the young ask to leave and clear new land in the hills.

options.label: Send families to found new hamlets

ai_eastafrica_almeida_at_kilwa.title: Portuguese Sails Off Kilwa
ai_eastafrica_almeida_at_kilwa.description: Francisco de Almeida's fleet anchors before Kilwa and demands tribute to the king of Portugal. His cannon outrange anything on your walls.

options.label: Pay tribute and keep the city
Abandon the town to the mainland

ai_eastafrica_mir_ali_bey_alliance.title: The Ottoman Corsair Arrives
ai_eastafrica_mir_ali_bey_alliance.description: The Ottoman captain Mir Ali Bey sails down the Somali coast promising to drive out the Portuguese. He asks your ports for men, ships and supplies.

options.label: Trade with him, but stay neutral

ai_eastafrica_mavura_vassal_treaty.title: A Crown Bought With Muskets
ai_eastafrica_mavura_vassal_treaty.description: A claimant backed by Portuguese guns offers to take the Mutapa throne and open the gold fields to their traders. Refusing means war with the prazo lords.

ai_eastafrica_radama_british_treaty.title: Muskets for the Slave Trade
ai_eastafrica_radama_british_treaty.description: British envoys from Mauritius offer arms, gold and instructors if you end the export of slaves from your lands. The slave traders at court are furious.

options.label: Keep the trade and its profits

ai_eastafrica_cape_fort_cattle.title: Strangers Build a Fort
ai_eastafrica_cape_fort_cattle.description: Dutch company men raise a fort at Table Bay and want your cattle for copper and tobacco. You know their language better than anyone on the shore.

options.label: Serve as their interpreter and broker
Drive the herds away from them

ai_eastafrica_general_commando.title: The Commando Rides North
ai_eastafrica_general_commando.description: Colonial farmers raise a great armed commando to clear your bands from the hunting grounds of the northern frontier. Your arrows cannot match their guns.

options.label: Raid their herds in the mountains

ai_eastafrica_baker_at_masindi.title: Baker Raises a Flag
ai_eastafrica_baker_at_masindi.description: The Egyptian Khedive's agent Samuel Baker plants a flag at Masindi and declares your kingdom annexed. His soldiers are few, but well armed.

ai_eastafrica_failing_furrows.title: The Furrows Run Dry
ai_eastafrica_failing_furrows.description: The streams feeding your stone irrigation channels are shrinking, and terraces lie bare. Herders from the plains eye the empty fields.

options.label: Turn to cattle and trade with herders

ai_steppe_fall_of_astrakhan.title: Muscovy Takes the Volga
ai_steppe_fall_of_astrakhan.description: Tsar Ivan's armies have seized the old khanate at the Volga mouth, and Russian boats now control the river trade your merchants depend on.

options.label: Accept Russian tolls and keep trading

ai_japan_rice_riots.title: Rice Riots Spread
ai_japan_rice_riots.description: Rice prices have doubled while merchants hoard grain, and fishermen's wives have started riots that now spread from town to town.

options.label: Open state rice stores at low prices

ai_japan_great_earthquake.title: The Great Earthquake
ai_japan_great_earthquake.description: A massive earthquake has struck at midday, and cooking fires have turned the wooden quarters of your city into a firestorm.

options.label: Rebuild quickly along the old streets

ai_japan_northern_famine.title: Cold Summer Famine
ai_japan_northern_famine.description: A cold summer has ruined the northern rice harvest, and starving farm families are selling their daughters to brokers from the cities.

options.label: Fund relief work and food shipments
Enlist the hungry sons into the army

ai_japan_war_loans.title: Paying for War
ai_japan_war_loans.description: War with Russia has begun, and your treasury cannot sustain it for more than a few months without new money.

options.label: Borrow from London and New York bankers
Raise heavy war taxes at home

ai_japan_zaibatsu_breakup.title: Breaking the Zaibatsu
ai_japan_zaibatsu_breakup.description: The occupation authorities demand that you dissolve the great family conglomerates that built your war economy.

options.label: Quietly let them regroup under banks

ai_japan_bullet_train_north.title: The Bullet Train North
ai_japan_bullet_train_north.description: Engineers propose extending the high speed line through the northern mountains to your city, at enormous cost in tunnels and viaducts.

options.label: Fund the line through the mountains

ai_japan_oil_shock.title: The Oil Shock
ai_japan_oil_shock.description: Arab producers have cut oil exports, and your factories, which run almost entirely on imported oil, face sudden shortages and soaring prices.

options.label: Ration energy and invest in efficiency

ai_japan_poisoned_bay.title: The Poisoned Bay
ai_japan_poisoned_bay.description: Doctors confirm that mercury from a chemical plant has poisoned fishing villages for years, and victims now protest outside the company gates.

options.label: Close the outflow and compensate victims
Protect the company and dispute the findings

ai_maghreb_great_man_made_river.title: Water Under the Sand
ai_maghreb_great_man_made_river.description: Engineers can pump the fossil aquifers beneath the Fezzan north to the coast through giant pipes. The water is ancient and will not return once drawn.

options.label: Build the pipeline to the coast
Keep the water for desert farms

ai_eastafrica_pirates_off_the_horn.title: Pirates Off the Horn
ai_eastafrica_pirates_off_the_horn.description: Fishermen turned raiders seize freighters off your coast and hold their crews for ransom. Foreign navies gather, and your own ports quietly profit from the trade.

ai_americas_caral_land_traffickers.title: Squatters by the Pyramids
ai_americas_caral_land_traffickers.description: Land traffickers fence off fields around Caral's ancient pyramids, and the archaeologists who guard the site receive death threats.

options.label: Send police to clear the land
Leave it to the slow courts

ai_americas_lithium_salt_flats.title: The White Gold Contract
ai_americas_lithium_salt_flats.description: Foreign firms bid to extract lithium from your salt flats, offering capital and know-how you lack but demanding a large share of the brine.

ai_americas_supermarket_near_pyramids.title: A Supermarket by the Pyramids
ai_americas_supermarket_near_pyramids.description: A retail chain has a permit to build a store within sight of the Pyramid of the Sun, and protesters camp at the gates.

ai_americas_earthquake_leogane.title: The Earth Splits
ai_americas_earthquake_leogane.description: A magnitude 7 earthquake levels towns around Jaragua. Aid planes jam the only airport while survivors dig through rubble by hand.

options.label: Let foreign troops run the relief
Direct relief through your own officials

ai_americas_after_hurricane_maria.title: After Hurricane Maria
ai_americas_after_hurricane_maria.description: A Category 5 storm has torn the roofs off nearly every house on the island. You can rebuild as before, or pay to rebuild against the next storm.

ai_americas_nunavut_civil_service.title: A Territory of Our Own
ai_americas_nunavut_civil_service.description: Nunavut is born and its new government must staff the ministries, but few trained civil servants speak Inuktitut.

options.label: Require Inuktitut in the civil service
Hire experienced officials from the south

ai_americas_chaco_drilling_buffer.title: Drilling Near the Great Houses
ai_americas_chaco_drilling_buffer.description: Oil and gas firms seek leases near Chaco's great houses. Pueblo leaders demand a ten-mile buffer, while some Navajo allottees want the royalties.

ai_americas_chips_in_the_desert.title: Chips in the Desert
ai_americas_chips_in_the_desert.description: A chipmaker offers to build a giant fab near your desert city, if you guarantee water from a river already running dry.

ai_israelite_jebusite_stronghold.title: The Jebusite Stronghold
ai_israelite_jebusite_stronghold.description: The Jebusites mock you from their hilltop fortress, boasting that even the blind and lame could hold it. Your men whisper of a water shaft leading inside.

options.label: Send fighters up the water shaft
Besiege and offer the Jebusites terms

ai_israelite_ark_to_jerusalem.title: Bringing Up the Ark
ai_israelite_ark_to_jerusalem.description: The Ark of the Covenant rests in a village house at Kiriath-jearim. Bringing it to your new capital would bind the tribes to Jerusalem, but the priests fear mishandling it.

options.label: Lead a grand procession with music
Leave the Ark where it rests

ai_israelite_cedars_of_tyre.title: Cedars from Tyre
ai_israelite_cedars_of_tyre.description: Hiram, king of Tyre, offers cedar logs, carpenters and masons to build you a palace. Phoenician craftsmen are the finest anywhere, but their friendship comes at a price in grain and oil.

options.label: Accept and pay Tyre in produce
Build with local stone and labor

ai_israelite_philistine_smiths.title: No Smith in Israel
ai_israelite_philistine_smiths.description: The Philistines guard the secret of ironworking, and your farmers must go down to them to sharpen every plowshare and axe. Your soldiers fight with few iron weapons.

options.label: Train Israelite smiths at great cost

ai_israelite_royal_census.title: Counting the People
ai_israelite_royal_census.description: Your commander proposes a census of every fighting man from Dan to Beersheba. It would make taxes and levies precise, yet prophets warn that numbering the people invites disaster.

options.label: Halt the census and offer sacrifices

ai_israelite_absalom_revolt.title: Absalom at Hebron
ai_israelite_absalom_revolt.description: Your son Absalom has stolen the hearts of the people at the city gate and been proclaimed king in Hebron. His army marches on Jerusalem.

options.label: Abandon Jerusalem and regroup beyond Jordan
Hold the city walls against him

ai_israelite_stepped_stone_terraces.title: Filling the Millo
ai_israelite_stepped_stone_terraces.description: The steep eastern slope of the City of David crumbles with every winter rain. Masons propose massive stone terraces to support new buildings and strengthen the citadel.

ai_israelite_arabah_copper.title: Furnaces of the Arabah
ai_israelite_arabah_copper.description: Smelting furnaces burn day and night in the copper valleys of the Arabah, south of the Dead Sea. Whoever controls them controls the bronze of the region.

options.label: Buy ingots from the desert smelters

ai_israelite_masoretic_codex.title: The Masoretes' Great Codex
ai_israelite_masoretic_codex.description: The scribes of Tiberias have fixed every vowel and accent of scripture in one master codex. They ask you to fund faithful copies for every synagogue.

options.label: Pay for copies in every province
Keep one codex, guarded in Jerusalem

ai_israelite_persian_march.title: The Persians at the Gates
ai_israelite_persian_march.description: A Sasanian army sweeps toward Jerusalem, and Jews of Galilee are marching with it against Byzantine rule. You must choose a side before the walls are breached.

ai_israelite_karaite_schism.title: Scripture Alone
ai_israelite_karaite_schism.description: Followers of Anan ben David reject the oral law of the rabbis and read only the written Torah. The academies demand you silence them.

ai_israelite_radhanite_charters.title: The Radhanite Road
ai_israelite_radhanite_charters.description: Jewish merchants who trade from the Frankish lands to China seek your protection for their caravans and ships. Their routes bring silk, spices and envy.

ai_israelite_crusader_siege.title: The Franks Besiege Jerusalem
ai_israelite_crusader_siege.description: A crusader army has encamped beneath the walls with siege towers. Defenders and scholars alike wait for your command.

options.label: Man the walls to the last
Send scrolls and families to Egypt

ai_israelite_resettle_jerusalem.title: Return to the City
ai_israelite_resettle_jerusalem.description: After Saladin retook Jerusalem, Jews were again permitted to settle there. Families from Ashkelon and the Maghreb await your help to make the journey.

options.label: Fund only a synagogue and yeshiva

ai_israelite_maimonidean_controversy.title: The Guide for the Perplexed
ai_israelite_maimonidean_controversy.description: Maimonides' philosophy divides your sages: some call it the crown of wisdom, others heresy fit for burning. Both camps want your verdict.

options.label: Ban the books in your lands

ai_israelite_sephardi_exiles.title: Exiles From Sepharad
ai_israelite_sephardi_exiles.description: Spain has expelled its Jews, and ships crowded with scholars, physicians and penniless families seek a harbor. Taking them in will strain your treasury.

options.label: Admit only the skilled and wealthy

ai_levant_hejaz_railway_station.title: The Railway Reaches Hegra
ai_levant_hejaz_railway_station.description: The Hejaz Railway now runs past the rock-cut tombs of Hegra, bringing pilgrims, soldiers and trade. The Bedouin who once earned their living guarding the caravans watch it with anger.

options.label: Build a fortified depot and garrison
Pay the tribes to protect the line

ai_levant_van_under_siege.title: Van Under Siege
ai_levant_van_under_siege.description: As war engulfs the eastern front, the Armenian quarter beneath the old citadel of Van barricades itself against Ottoman forces. The city's fate will echo far beyond its walls.

options.label: Send troops to break the siege

ai_levant_ras_shamra_tablets.title: Tablets at Ras Shamra
ai_levant_ras_shamra_tablets.description: A farmer's plow struck a buried tomb, and now a French mission is unearthing clay tablets in an unknown alphabet. Scholars across the world are clamoring for access.

options.label: Fund the excavation and keep the finds
Let the foreign mission take the tablets

ai_levant_midas_mound_opened.title: Opening the Great Tumulus
ai_levant_midas_mound_opened.description: American archaeologists have tunneled into the great burial mound at Gordion and found an intact wooden tomb chamber. Tourists, scholars and looters all take notice.

options.label: Build a museum at the site

ai_levant_sinop_listening_post.title: Ears on the Black Sea
ai_levant_sinop_listening_post.description: Your allies ask to build a listening station on the Sinop headland to track Soviet missile tests across the sea. The rent is generous, but Moscow is watching.

options.label: Lease the headland to your allies
Refuse foreign troops on your soil

ai_levant_gabala_radar.title: The Radar at Gabala
ai_levant_gabala_radar.description: Engineers from Moscow are raising a vast early-warning radar in the hills near Gabala. It promises jobs and protection, but locals fear for their orchards and their health.

options.label: Welcome the station and its workers

ai_levant_marib_oil_strike.title: Oil Beneath Marib
ai_levant_marib_oil_strike.description: An American company has struck oil in the desert basin near Marib, where the old Sabaean capital lies in ruins. The tribes of the region expect their share.

options.label: Grant the foreign company a concession
Share revenues with the local tribes

ai_levant_marib_dam_rebuilt.title: A New Marib Dam
ai_levant_marib_dam_rebuilt.description: A Gulf ruler offers to fund a modern dam near the ruins of the ancient Marib Dam, reviving the fields of old Saba. His generosity will come with expectations.

options.label: Accept the gift and its strings
Build it from your own treasury

ai_westafrica_terracotta_workshops.title: The Clay Sculptors
ai_westafrica_terracotta_workshops.description: Potters in Nok are shaping large clay figures with elaborate hair and pierced eyes. Elders want them for shrines and graves, but firing them consumes much fuel and labor.

options.label: Fund the workshops for the shrines
Keep the potters making household wares

ai_westafrica_pearl_millet_fields.title: The New Grain
ai_westafrica_pearl_millet_fields.description: Villagers at the forest edge have begun sowing pearl millet beside their yams and oil palms. Clearing more land feeds more mouths, but it strips the woods your hunters rely on.

options.label: Keep the old balance of forest and field

ai_westafrica_first_furnaces.title: Fire That Melts Stone
ai_westafrica_first_furnaces.description: Smiths claim that red stone heated in clay furnaces yields a hard grey metal. The trials burn whole groves of charcoal and most attempts fail.

options.label: Give the smiths charcoal and laborers
Forbid the waste of good timber

ai_westafrica_forest_yam_clearing.title: The Sacred Grove
ai_westafrica_forest_yam_clearing.description: Farmers around Ile-Ife want to burn a grove for new yam mounds. The priests say spirits dwell there and will turn against the town.

options.label: Let the farmers burn the grove

ai_westafrica_lake_fishing_dispute.title: Quarrel Over the Marshes
ai_westafrica_lake_fishing_dispute.description: Two clans claim the same fish-rich marshes. Each brings dried fish as tribute and asks you to drive the other off.

ai_westafrica_savanna_drought.title: The Rains Fail
ai_westafrica_savanna_drought.description: For a second year the rains have come late and the river runs thin. Families are leaving for the forest valleys, taking their strength with them.

options.label: Open the granaries to the villages
Let the families go to the valleys

ai_westafrica_salt_traders.title: Salt From the Coast
ai_westafrica_salt_traders.description: Traders arrive in Kabasa with blocks of salt from the coastal pans. They want a fixed market and safe passage, and they ask a share of every exchange.

options.label: Send your own carriers to the coast

ai_westafrica_newcomers_from_north.title: Newcomers With Pots
ai_westafrica_newcomers_from_north.description: Bands of farmers speaking a related tongue arrive from the north, carrying pottery and yam cuttings. Your hunters fear for their grounds.

options.label: Turn them back at the river

ai_mesopotamia_foothill_oil_strike.title: Oil in the Foothills
ai_mesopotamia_foothill_oil_strike.description: After years of dry wells, a foreign drilling crew strikes a gusher in the hills of your southwest. They want a long concession to pump and ship it.

ai_mesopotamia_northern_gusher_pipeline.title: The Northern Gusher
ai_mesopotamia_northern_gusher_pipeline.description: A well near the old fire pits of the north erupts, flooding the plain with crude for days. Investors offer to build a pipeline to the Mediterranean in exchange for a share.

ai_mesopotamia_first_gulf_oil.title: First Oil of the Gulf
ai_mesopotamia_first_gulf_oil.description: Drillers on your island hit oil beneath the central hill, the first find on the Arab shore of the Gulf. Your advisers argue over how fast to pump.

options.label: Save revenue for schools and clinics

ai_mesopotamia_pearl_market_collapse.title: The Pearl Market Collapses
ai_mesopotamia_pearl_market_collapse.description: Cheap cultured pearls from Japan and the world slump have crushed prices, and your pearling fleets sit idle with their divers deep in debt.

options.label: Send divers to the oil fields

ai_mesopotamia_statue_at_tell_hariri.title: A Statue in the Sand
ai_mesopotamia_statue_at_tell_hariri.description: Tribesmen digging a grave on a mound by the Euphrates uncover an ancient headless statue. Foreign archaeologists ask for a permit to excavate the whole site.

options.label: Keep finds in a national museum

ai_mesopotamia_oil_nationalization.title: Whose Oil Is It
ai_mesopotamia_oil_nationalization.description: Crowds and parliament demand that the foreign oil company be seized. Its government threatens a blockade of your exports if you dare.

ai_mesopotamia_euphrates_dam.title: Damming the Euphrates
ai_mesopotamia_euphrates_dam.description: Soviet engineers are ready to close a great dam on the Euphrates, promising power and irrigation. The reservoir will drown dozens of villages and ancient mounds.

options.label: Close the dam and relocate villagers
Delay to rescue the ancient sites

ai_mesopotamia_war_over_shatt.title: War Over the Waterway
ai_mesopotamia_war_over_shatt.description: Your neighbor across the shared river mouth is in revolutionary chaos, and your generals say one swift strike could seize the waterway and its oil province.

ai_europe_knossos_excavation.title: The Mound at Knossos
ai_europe_knossos_excavation.description: A British archaeologist has bought land over the Kephala mound and asks permission to dig for the palace of legend.

options.label: Demand that finds stay on Crete

ai_europe_numantia_dig.title: Who Digs Numantia
ai_europe_numantia_dig.description: A German scholar has begun uncovering the Roman siege camps around Numantia, and Spanish patriots demand the ruins be studied by Spaniards.

ai_europe_maiden_castle_dig.title: Digging Through the Slump
ai_europe_maiden_castle_dig.description: Archaeologists want to excavate the great ramparts of Maiden Castle, and hundreds of local men idled by the Depression are asking for the work.

ai_europe_berlin_blockade.title: The City Cut Off
ai_europe_berlin_blockade.description: Soviet forces have closed every road and rail line into West Berlin, leaving two million people with weeks of food and coal.

options.label: Accept Soviet terms for the city

ai_europe_budapest_uprising.title: Students in the Streets
ai_europe_budapest_uprising.description: Students and workers have toppled a giant statue of Stalin and demand free elections and the withdrawal of Soviet troops.

ai_europe_north_sea_oil.title: Oil Off the Coast
ai_europe_north_sea_oil.description: Drillers in the North Sea have struck a vast oil field, and foreign companies are crowding into the harbors of Rogaland.

ai_europe_navan_quarry.title: The Quarry Advances
ai_europe_navan_quarry.description: A limestone quarry beside Emain Macha seeks to expand toward the ancient mound, and campaigners warn the royal site will be lost.

options.label: Halt the quarry and protect the site

ai_europe_chernobyl_reactor.title: Fire at the Reactor
ai_europe_chernobyl_reactor.description: A reactor at Chernobyl has exploded, and a radioactive cloud drifts over villages and fields while officials wait for orders.

options.label: Evacuate widely and admit the truth
Downplay it and keep parades running

ai_pacific_sweet_potato_arrives.title: The Sweet Potato Arrives
ai_pacific_sweet_potato_arrives.description: A new tuber passed from valley to valley grows on cold, high slopes where taro fails. Your elders debate whether to remake the old gardens around it.

options.label: Plant mounded fields on every slope

ai_pacific_great_pig_exchange.title: The Great Pig Exchange
ai_pacific_great_pig_exchange.description: Neighboring clans expect you to host a ceremonial exchange of pigs and shells. Generosity buys alliances, but your herds are thin after a dry season.

options.label: Give lavishly before all the clans
Hold back and keep the herds

ai_pacific_manila_galleon_stop.title: The Galleon Drops Anchor
ai_pacific_manila_galleon_stop.description: A great Spanish ship bound from Acapulco to Manila anchors offshore, its crew desperate for water and fresh food. They offer iron for provisions.

options.label: Keep canoes away from the strangers

ai_pacific_mission_on_guam.title: Priests and Soldiers
ai_pacific_mission_on_guam.description: Spanish missionaries baptize children and preach against the old ways, guarded by soldiers. Some chiefs urge war, others see power in the new faith.

options.label: Accept the mission and its schools
Join the chiefs rising in arms

ai_pacific_whalers_in_harbor.title: Whalers in the Harbor
ai_pacific_whalers_in_harbor.description: American whaling ships crowd your lagoon, paying in cloth, tools and tobacco for yams and water. Their sailors bring drink, quarrels and sickness ashore.

ai_pacific_labor_recruiters.title: The Labor Recruiters
ai_pacific_labor_recruiters.description: Recruiting ships seek young men for plantations in Queensland and Samoa, offering axes and rifles to their kin. Not all who leave return.

options.label: Let the young men sign on

ai_pacific_shipwrecked_musketeers.title: Muskets from a Wreck
ai_pacific_shipwrecked_musketeers.description: Castaway sailors with muskets salvaged from a wrecked brig offer to fight for Bau. Firearms could crush your rivals, but the foreigners demand wives and honors.

options.label: Send them to a rival chief

ai_pacific_cession_to_britain.title: The Offer of Cession
ai_pacific_cession_to_britain.description: Foreign debts, unruly settlers and rival chiefs strain your new kingdom. British envoys propose that you cede Fiji to their Queen in exchange for order.

options.label: Keep the crown and the debts

ai_monsoon_strangers_seek_gold.title: Strangers Seeking Gold
ai_monsoon_strangers_seek_gold.description: Battered foreign ships have arrived, and their men stare at the gold ornaments your people wear. They offer iron blades and cloth for the metal.

options.label: Feast them and send them away

ai_monsoon_company_pepper_monopoly.title: The Company Wants Pepper
ai_monsoon_company_pepper_monopoly.description: The Dutch East India Company demands sole right to buy your pepper at its own price. Its warships wait in the Musi River.

ai_monsoon_march_on_batavia.title: March on Batavia
ai_monsoon_march_on_batavia.description: The Dutch fort at Batavia defies your claim over all Java. Your generals ask for a great army and rice barges to besiege it.

options.label: Tolerate the fort, tax its trade

ai_monsoon_hue_ends_panduranga.title: Hue Ends the Autonomy
ai_monsoon_hue_ends_panduranga.description: The court at Hue has abolished the last Cham principality and sends mandarins to rule Panduranga directly. Many Cham speak of flight to Cambodia.

ai_monsoon_toungoo_at_the_gates.title: Toungoo at the Gates
ai_monsoon_toungoo_at_the_gates.description: The Toungoo king besieges Prome beside the old Pyu walls. Allies from Ava promise help, but their army is slow.

ai_monsoon_restore_great_stupa.title: Restore the Great Stupa
ai_monsoon_restore_great_stupa.description: The ancient stupa of Nakhon Pathom lies overgrown in the jungle. The king wishes to encase it in a vast new chedi, a work of many years.

ai_monsoon_settlers_at_eel_traps.title: Sheep on the Eel Country
ai_monsoon_settlers_at_eel_traps.description: Squatters have driven flocks onto the stone channels and eel traps your ancestors built. Young men want to raid the stations; elders fear the troopers.

ai_europe_phocaean_walls.title: Silver for the Phocaeans
ai_europe_phocaean_walls.description: Greek traders from Phocaea refuse your offer to settle in your land. Fearing the Medes at home, they ask for silver to wall their own city instead.

options.label: Pay for their walls in silver
Insist they settle along your river

ai_europe_cimbri_at_noreia.title: Wanderers at Noreia
ai_europe_cimbri_at_noreia.description: A vast host of Cimbri wanders toward Noreia. Roman envoys order them away, while a Roman consul waits in the passes with his legions.

options.label: Trust Rome to fight for you
Pay the Cimbri to move on
Arm the ironworkers and hold the walls

ai_europe_roman_envoys_piracy.title: Roman Envoys at Court
ai_europe_roman_envoys_piracy.description: Roman envoys demand that you stop Illyrian ships from plundering Italian merchants. Your captains call raiding their ancient right, and the younger envoy speaks to you insolently.

options.label: Curb only the royal fleet's raids
Let the captains sail as they please

ai_europe_friend_of_rome.title: Friend of the Roman People
ai_europe_friend_of_rome.description: You have trapped the consul Servilianus and his army in a gorge. He offers peace: your lands recognized and you named a friend of Rome, if his men may leave.

options.label: Accept and let the army go

ai_europe_siege_ring.title: The Ring Around Numantia
ai_europe_siege_ring.description: Scipio has sealed Numantia inside walls, towers and camps. Hunger grows, and the council debates sending riders through the lines to beg the Arevaci towns for aid.

options.label: Send Retogenes's riders out by night
Ration the grain and hold the walls

ai_europe_scorched_earth.title: Burn the Granaries
ai_europe_scorched_earth.description: To starve Caesar's legions, you would burn every Biturigan town and farm in their path. The Bituriges beg you to spare Avaricum, their finest city.

ai_europe_fugitive_caratacus.title: A Fugitive King
ai_europe_fugitive_caratacus.description: Caratacus, beaten by the Romans in the west, seeks shelter among your Brigantes. Rome watches to see whether its client queen keeps faith.

options.label: Chain him and hand him to Rome

ai_europe_uproot_vines.title: Uproot the Vines
ai_europe_uproot_vines.description: Your high priest Decaeneus urges you to tear up the vineyards so the Dacians stay sober and obedient. Nobles and wine merchants grumble at the thought.

ai_americas_empty_nets.title: The Nets Come Up Empty
ai_americas_empty_nets.description: Warm waters off the coast have driven away the anchovy shoals, and the fishing villages ask Caral for cotton and squash on credit.

options.label: Open the city stores to the coast
Keep the stores for Caral alone
Send the fishers inland to farm

ai_americas_shicra_foundations.title: Bags of Stone
ai_americas_shicra_foundations.description: Your builders propose raising the next platform on shicra, reed bags packed with stones that shift and settle when the earth shakes.

options.label: Build quickly with loose rubble fill

ai_americas_magnetite_mirrors.title: Mirrors for the Gulf
ai_americas_magnetite_mirrors.description: Craftsmen in your valley polish magnetite into small mirrors, and traders from the Gulf coast offer shells and fine goods for every one they can carry.

options.label: Keep the mirrors for our own chiefs

ai_americas_burning_the_forest.title: Burning the Forest
ai_americas_burning_the_forest.description: Settlers on the Petén ridges want to burn wide tracts of forest for maize, though the elders warn the thin soil tires after a few harvests.

options.label: Clear slowly and leave land fallow

ai_americas_copper_from_north.title: Copper from the North
ai_americas_copper_from_north.description: Traders speak of pure copper lying in the ground by the great northern lakes, a long journey by canoe and foot from your mounds.

options.label: Send traders north with stone beads
Rely on local chert and stone

ai_americas_soapstone_lamps.title: Lamps Against the Dark
ai_americas_soapstone_lamps.description: A colder age grips the Arctic, and your hunters ask whether to carve soapstone lamps and winter on the sea ice or follow the caribou.

options.label: Carve lamps and hunt seals on ice

ai_americas_fields_above_frost.title: Fields Above the Frost
ai_americas_fields_above_frost.description: Farmers by Lake Titicaca find that crops on raised beds between water channels survive the killing night frosts of the high plain.

options.label: Herd llamas on the puna instead

ai_americas_seeds_from_south.title: Seeds from the South
ai_americas_seeds_from_south.description: Wanderers from the south bring a strange grass with fat ears of grain, but it demands water and settled fields in your dry canyons.

options.label: Keep gathering wild seeds and game

ai_korea_gold_collection_drive.title: The Gold Collection Drive
ai_korea_gold_collection_drive.description: The currency has collapsed and foreign lenders demand harsh reforms. Ordinary families offer their wedding rings and heirlooms to help repay the national debt.

options.label: Accept the lenders' terms in full

ai_korea_arduous_march.title: The Arduous March
ai_korea_arduous_march.description: Floods and the loss of old allies have emptied the granaries. Hunger spreads through the villages while the army still eats first.

options.label: Accept foreign food aid and monitors
Keep the army first, ration the rest

ai_korea_broadband_for_all.title: Fiber to Every Home
ai_korea_broadband_for_all.description: Internet cafes are packed every night and engineers say the city could be wired faster than any in the world, if the state pays for it.

options.label: Fund fiber lines to every apartment
Leave it to the telecom firms

ai_korea_summit_in_the_north.title: A Summit Across the Border
ai_korea_summit_in_the_north.description: An invitation arrives to meet the northern leader face to face. Critics whisper that the meeting will cost far more than anyone admits.

ai_korea_underground_test.title: The Mountain Test Site
ai_korea_underground_test.description: Your scientists report the device is ready beneath the mountain. A test would prove your strength but bring sanctions from every major power.

options.label: Hold it back as a bargaining chip

ai_korea_joint_industrial_zone.title: Factories for Southern Firms
ai_korea_joint_industrial_zone.description: Southern companies offer to build factories near the border and pay wages in hard currency. Your workers would see how the other side lives.

options.label: Open the zone to southern firms

ai_korea_ancient_capital_ruins.title: Ruins of the Old Capital
ai_korea_ancient_capital_ruins.description: Archaeologists have uncovered palace foundations beneath the town, and world heritage status is within reach. Developers want the same land for hotels.

ai_korea_whose_ancient_kingdom.title: Whose Ancient Kingdom?
ai_korea_whose_ancient_kingdom.description: Scholars in a powerful neighbor now teach that your ancestors' kingdoms were their own provinces. Your people demand an answer.

ai_korea_memory_chip_wager.title: The Memory Chip Wager
ai_korea_memory_chip_wager.description: Your chaebol leaders believe they can overtake the world's chipmakers, but only with cheap state loans and years of losses.

options.label: Back the chip fabs with state loans

ai_pacific_sokehs_rebellion.title: The Sokehs Rebellion
ai_pacific_sokehs_rebellion.description: German officials force the men of Sokehs into unpaid road labor, and after a beating the workers kill the district officer. Warships are already on their way.

ai_pacific_highland_first_contact.title: Strangers Over the Ridge
ai_pacific_highland_first_contact.description: An Australian patrol hunting for gold walks into the Wahgi Valley, a land outsiders believed empty. They carry shells and steel axes to trade.

ai_pacific_guam_occupation.title: The Island Falls
ai_pacific_guam_occupation.description: Japanese troops land on Guam hours after Pearl Harbor, and the small American garrison surrenders. The Chamorro people must live under the new occupiers.

ai_pacific_wahgi_coffee.title: The Coffee Boom
ai_pacific_wahgi_coffee.description: Planters in the Wahgi Valley pay well for coffee, and clans are clearing garden land to grow their own bushes. Food gardens shrink as the cash comes in.

ai_pacific_fiji_independence.title: A Flag of Our Own
ai_pacific_fiji_independence.description: Britain is ready to grant Fiji independence, but chiefs, Indo-Fijian leaders and London argue over who will hold power. Your word as high chief carries weight.

ai_pacific_kuk_ditches.title: Ditches Beneath the Swamp
ai_pacific_kuk_ditches.description: Archaeologists digging at the Kuk tea station find ancient drainage channels that may be among the oldest farming works on Earth. The planters want the land back.

ai_pacific_lapita_homeland_dig.title: The Potters' Stilt Village
ai_pacific_lapita_homeland_dig.description: Foreign scholars ask to excavate the old stilt village on Mussau, where stamped Lapita pottery lies in the lagoon mud. Villagers fear disturbing ancestral ground.

ai_pacific_fiji_coup.title: Soldiers in Parliament
ai_pacific_fiji_coup.description: An army officer storms Parliament and overthrows the newly elected government, claiming to defend Fijian chiefly rule. Bau must decide where it stands.

ai_steppe_khagan_chooses_faith.title: The Khagan Chooses a Faith
ai_steppe_khagan_chooses_faith.description: Christian envoys from Constantinople and Muslim envoys from the Caliphate each press you to adopt their faith. Rabbis among your merchants offer a third path that binds you to neither empire.

ai_steppe_volga_river_tithe.title: Tithe on the Volga
ai_steppe_volga_river_tithe.description: Rus boats laden with furs and slaves pass Atil on their way to the Caspian. Your customs men can take a tenth of every cargo, but the Rus grow restless at the price.

options.label: Lower the toll to keep peace

ai_steppe_smiths_of_the_rouran.title: Smiths No Longer
ai_steppe_smiths_of_the_rouran.description: The Rouran khagan scorned your request for a royal bride, calling your people his blacksmith slaves. Your forges have armed many warriors, and the Western Wei offer a princess of their own.

options.label: Rise in revolt against the Rouran
Marry into the Wei court first
Swallow the insult and keep forging

ai_steppe_silk_embassy_west.title: Silk for Constantinople
ai_steppe_silk_embassy_west.description: Persia burned your merchants' silk rather than let it pass west. Your trader Maniakh proposes carrying it around Persia, straight to the Roman emperor, by the long northern road.

ai_steppe_paper_mills_samarkand.title: The Paper Makers
ai_steppe_paper_mills_samarkand.description: Craftsmen in the city have learned to make paper from rags and flax, cheaper than parchment or papyrus. Scribes from Baghdad already ask for more than the mills can make.

options.label: Keep the craft a guarded secret

ai_steppe_river_eats_kath.title: The River Eats Kath
ai_steppe_river_eats_kath.description: The shifting Oxus has swallowed whole quarters of your old capital, and the citadel walls now lean over the water. Rival Gurganj, safely upstream, grows richer every year.

options.label: Build dikes to hold the river
Move the court to safer ground

ai_steppe_tang_princess_bride.title: A Princess From Chang'an
ai_steppe_tang_princess_bride.description: After your armies pressed on the Tang frontier, the emperor agrees to send Princess Wencheng as a bride. Her retinue brings Buddhist monks, artisans and Chinese ways your nobles distrust.

options.label: Accept the bride, dismiss the monks

ai_steppe_karakhanid_holy_war.title: War With Kashgar
ai_steppe_karakhanid_holy_war.description: The Muslim Karakhanids of Kashgar have warred on your Buddhist kingdom for decades. Your monasteries hold jade and gold enough to hire more soldiers, but the abbots refuse to give it.

options.label: Beg aid from Dunhuang and Tibet

ai_mesopotamia_portuguese_pearl_tribute.title: Portuguese Sails Off Bahrain
ai_mesopotamia_portuguese_pearl_tribute.description: A Portuguese fleet from Hormuz anchors off your pearl banks and demands yearly tribute in exchange for leaving your divers and dhows alone.

ai_mesopotamia_shah_and_sultan.title: Between Shah and Sultan
ai_mesopotamia_shah_and_sultan.description: Ottoman and Safavid armies march down the Tigris toward Baghdad, and both demand that your tribes declare for them before the summer campaign.

ai_mesopotamia_foreign_gunners.title: English Gunners at Court
ai_mesopotamia_foreign_gunners.description: Two English adventurers arrive offering to train your soldiers in cannon casting and musket drill, but your old cavalry chiefs resent foreign hands on the army.

options.label: Hire them and build a musket corps

ai_mesopotamia_caravan_tolls.title: The Aleppo Caravans
ai_mesopotamia_caravan_tolls.description: Great caravans carrying Indian cloth and spices between Basra and Aleppo now pass beneath your walls along the Euphrates, and merchants complain of desert raiders.

ai_mesopotamia_plague_and_flood.title: Plague Behind the Levees
ai_mesopotamia_plague_and_flood.description: Plague has reached the markets just as the river rises against the levees, and your officials cannot both close the gates and gather workers for the dikes.

ai_mesopotamia_euphrates_steamers.title: Steamers on the Euphrates
ai_mesopotamia_euphrates_steamers.description: British officers haul iron steamboats overland from the coast and ask leave to survey the Euphrates as a fast route to India.

options.label: Grant passage and sell them coal
Forbid foreign ships on the river

ai_mesopotamia_telegraph_line.title: The Wire to India
ai_mesopotamia_telegraph_line.description: Engineers ask to run a telegraph line across your lands toward the Gulf, offering you a station and fees, though tribes fear the poles mark future conquest.

options.label: Allow the line and guard it

ai_mesopotamia_french_excavators.title: Diggers in the Ancient Mound
ai_mesopotamia_french_excavators.description: A French couple uncovers glazed brick friezes of ancient archers in the old mound and asks permission to ship them to Paris.

ai_indic_harappa_salt_bricks.title: Salt Eats the Bricks
ai_indic_harappa_salt_bricks.description: Groundwater salts are crumbling Harappa's excavated walls, and the archaeologists say only costly drainage and reburial can save them.

options.label: Fund drainage and rebury exposed walls
Open the mound wider for tourists

ai_indic_taxila_foundries_stupas.title: Foundries Beside the Stupas
ai_indic_taxila_foundries_stupas.description: Heavy industry around Takshashila brings jobs and arms contracts, but heritage experts warn that dust and blasting are cracking the nearby Buddhist monasteries.

options.label: Expand the works, the army needs them
Zone a protected buffer around the ruins

ai_indic_lothal_maritime_complex.title: A Museum for the Dockyard
ai_indic_lothal_maritime_complex.description: Planners want a vast maritime heritage complex at Lothal's ancient dock, but the same budget could dredge working ports along the Gujarat coast.

ai_indic_ujjain_simhastha_water.title: Millions Come to the Kshipra
ai_indic_ujjain_simhastha_water.description: The Simhastha fair draws tens of millions of pilgrims to Ujjayini's ghats, yet the Kshipra runs too low to bathe in without piping in Narmada water.

options.label: Pipe in water from the Narmada

ai_indic_hastinapura_legend_dig.title: Digging Under Legend
ai_indic_hastinapura_legend_dig.description: Hastinapura is named an iconic heritage site, and many believers expect the excavators to prove the Mahabharata true.

ai_indic_nalanda_revival.title: Reviving Nalanda
ai_indic_nalanda_revival.description: A new Nalanda University opens near Rajagriha, and Asian partners offer money if the old monastic center becomes an international campus.

ai_indic_brahmaputra_floods.title: The Brahmaputra Rises
ai_indic_brahmaputra_floods.description: Monsoon floods drown thousands of villages across the old lands of Kamarupa, and Kaziranga's rhinos flee toward the highway.

options.label: Send the army to rescue villages

ai_indic_chandraketugarh_terracottas.title: Terracottas on the Black Market
ai_indic_chandraketugarh_terracottas.description: Farmers near Chandraketugarh dig up terracotta figures and sell them to dealers abroad, while the site still lacks a full excavation.

options.label: Buy the finds from the farmers
Police the fields and arrest dealers

ai_americas_french_at_guanabara.title: Frenchmen in the Bay
ai_americas_french_at_guanabara.description: French ships have anchored in Guanabara Bay, offering iron tools and muskets for brazilwood and warriors against the Portuguese and their allies.

options.label: Arm your warriors with French guns
Keep all strangers at a distance

ai_americas_governors_feast.title: The Governor's Visit
ai_americas_governors_feast.description: The Spanish governor Ovando is marching to Jaragua with horsemen, asking you to gather your caciques for a feast in his honor.

options.label: Host the feast with all chiefs
Send the chiefs into the mountains

ai_americas_neutral_island_treaty.title: A Treaty for Dominica
ai_americas_neutral_island_treaty.description: English and French envoys propose leaving Dominica to the Kalinago if your canoes stop raiding their sugar islands.

ai_americas_quesada_on_the_savanna.title: Strangers on the Savanna
ai_americas_quesada_on_the_savanna.description: Bearded men led by Jiménez de Quesada have climbed onto the high savanna, asking where the emeralds and gold of Bacatá come from.

options.label: Hide the treasure and abandon Bacatá
Fight them at the city's fences

ai_americas_sea_otter_traders.title: The Fur Traders Return
ai_americas_sea_otter_traders.description: An American ship that once humiliated you has returned to trade for sea otter pelts, its deck lined with muskets and cloth.
