options.label: Attack the ship to restore your honor

ai_americas_jesuit_mission_calos.title: Priests at Calos
ai_americas_jesuit_mission_calos.description: Spanish Jesuits have built a mission and blockhouse beside your town, promising friendship if your people abandon their old rites.

options.label: Burn the mission and expel them

ai_americas_false_inca_bohorquez.title: A Spaniard Claims Inca Blood
ai_americas_false_inca_bohorquez.description: Pedro Bohórquez, a Spanish adventurer calling himself the heir of the Incas, asks the valley to crown him and rise against Spanish rule.

options.label: Use him, but guard the passes

ai_americas_zapotec_spanish_alliance.title: After Tenochtitlan Falls
ai_americas_zapotec_spanish_alliance.description: The Mexica capital has fallen to Cortés, and his captains are riding south toward the Zapotec valleys, asking for submission and tribute.

ai_sinic_three_gorges_dam.title: Damming the Great River
ai_sinic_three_gorges_dam.description: Engineers propose a vast dam across the Yangtze gorges to tame floods and light a million homes. Over a million people would have to leave villages their families have farmed for centuries.

options.label: Build the dam and relocate the villages
Build smaller dams on the tributaries
Leave the river as it is

ai_sinic_southern_factory_zone.title: Factories of the Pearl River
ai_sinic_southern_factory_zone.description: Foreign investors offer to fill the Pearl River delta with factories if you loosen the rules on trade and land. Workers would pour in from the countryside faster than housing can be built.

ai_sinic_sichuan_earthquake.title: The Mountains Shake
ai_sinic_sichuan_earthquake.description: A great earthquake tears through the Sichuan hills, flattening schools and towns. Grieving parents ask why so many classrooms collapsed while other buildings stood.

options.label: Send the army and rebuild at once

ai_sinic_oracle_bone_heritage.title: Ruins of the Oracle Bones
ai_sinic_oracle_bone_heritage.description: International heritage experts want to list the ancient ruins of Yin, home of the oracle bones. The listing would bring tourists but forbid the factories planned on the site.

options.label: Protect the ruins and seek the listing
Let the industrial park go ahead

ai_sinic_online_marketplace.title: Merchants Go Online
ai_sinic_online_marketplace.description: A former English teacher and his friends start an internet marketplace from a small apartment. Bankers call it a fad, but local workshops are already selling to buyers overseas.

options.label: Back the startups with cheap loans
Tax the new trade like any other

ai_sinic_southern_railway.title: Rails to the South
ai_sinic_southern_railway.description: A new railway would tunnel through the Yunnan mountains to Laos and beyond. Neighbors welcome the trade but worry about the debts their governments must carry for it.

options.label: Share costs and ownership with neighbors
Upgrade the old mountain roads instead

ai_sinic_barbecue_craze.title: The Barbecue Craze
ai_sinic_barbecue_craze.description: Videos of the town's cheap skewer stalls go viral, and students arrive by the trainload. Hotels are full, prices are rising, and residents complain about the crowds.

options.label: Add trains and cap hotel prices

ai_sinic_freight_trains_west.title: Freight Trains to Europe
ai_sinic_freight_trains_west.description: Old Silk Road cities in the west want regular freight trains running across Central Asia to Europe. The trains are slower than planes, costlier than ships, and need heavy subsidies.

options.label: Keep trade on the coastal ports

ai_maghreb_ransom_of_alcacer.title: Captives of Three Kings
ai_maghreb_ransom_of_alcacer.description: After the Portuguese army is shattered at Alcácer Quibir, thousands of noble captives fill your camps. Lisbon's families beg to buy them back, while your commanders want them kept as leverage.

options.label: Sell them back at high ransom
Free some as a gesture to Europe

ai_maghreb_musketeers_at_the_gates.title: Musketeers on the Niger
ai_maghreb_musketeers_at_the_gates.description: Moroccan musketeers who broke the Songhay at Tondibi now march up the river. The city's merchants and scholars debate whether to open the gates or trust the flood plains and walls.

ai_maghreb_turkish_musketeers.title: Guns from the Ottomans
ai_maghreb_turkish_musketeers.description: Envoys returning from Tripoli offer Turkish musketeers and firearms for your army. They come dear, and your old cavalry nobles resent soldiers who answer only to the throne.

ai_maghreb_siege_of_constantine.title: French Guns Below the Rock
ai_maghreb_siege_of_constantine.description: A French army has returned to besiege the city on its gorge after failing the year before. Their siege artillery is heavier now, and the defenders are short of powder.

ai_maghreb_ottoman_tripoli.title: The Sultan's New Province
ai_maghreb_ottoman_tripoli.description: Ottoman corsairs have driven the Knights of Saint John out of Tripoli, and their governor demands that the eastern tribes and towns recognize the Sultan.

ai_maghreb_fezzan_caravan_tax.title: Toll on the Caravans
ai_maghreb_fezzan_caravan_tax.description: Caravans between Bornu and Tripoli pass your oases loaded with slaves, ivory and cloth. A new ruling house at Murzuq is competing for the same traffic with lower tolls.

ai_maghreb_char_bouba_war.title: Warriors Against Scholars
ai_maghreb_char_bouba_war.description: The Char Bouba war divides the desert: Arab warrior clans fight the Berber scholarly lineages. Both sides demand your caravan towns choose, and both threaten the salt roads.

options.label: Pay both sides to stay away

ai_maghreb_corsair_licenses.title: Licenses for the Corsairs
ai_maghreb_corsair_licenses.description: Corsair captains of Algiers bring rich prizes and European captives home each season. European fleets now threaten to bombard the harbor unless the raids are curbed.

options.label: Sign a truce with the Europeans

ai_maghreb_goats_on_the_green_mountain.title: Goats in the Cave
ai_maghreb_goats_on_the_green_mountain.description: Families sheltering in the great caves of the Green Mountain now pen sheep and goats beside their hearths, but the flocks strip the hillside shrubs.

options.label: Raise larger flocks on the slopes
Keep hunting the wild Barbary sheep

ai_maghreb_painted_rock_shelters.title: Paintings on the Rock
ai_maghreb_painted_rock_shelters.description: Your painters cover the shelters of the Acacus with cattle, dancers and masked figures, and herders travel far to see them.

options.label: Feed the painters through the dry season
Send the painters back to the herds

ai_maghreb_snail_shell_mounds.title: The Snail Mounds
ai_maghreb_snail_shell_mounds.description: Your camps sit on mounds of land snail shells left by generations, yet some families now want to herd sheep and leave the old sites.

options.label: Keep the old camps and gathering
Take up flocks and move with them

ai_maghreb_ivory_across_the_strait.title: Ivory Across the Strait
ai_maghreb_ivory_across_the_strait.description: Boatmen from the northern shore cross the strait seeking elephant tusks, and offer fine pottery and copper trinkets in return.

options.label: Trade a little, learn their crafts

ai_maghreb_stone_walled_villages.title: Walls of Dry Stone
ai_maghreb_stone_walled_villages.description: Herders settling along the cliffs begin to ring their compounds with dry stone walls, though hauling the stone takes hands from the cattle.

options.label: Keep the people with the herds

ai_maghreb_the_drying_pastures.title: The Pastures Wither
ai_maghreb_the_drying_pastures.description: The rains fail year after year, the lakes shrink to salt pans, and your elders argue whether to drive the cattle south.

options.label: Drive the herds south to wetter land

ai_maghreb_bone_harpoons.title: Harpoons of Bone
ai_maghreb_bone_harpoons.description: Your fishers carve barbed bone harpoons and take great catfish and perch from the flooded channels, but the floods rise without warning.

options.label: Build camps close to the water
Camp on high ground, fish less

ai_maghreb_the_shrinking_lake.title: The Great Lake Shrinks
ai_maghreb_the_shrinking_lake.description: The vast lake your ancestors fished pulls back from its old shores, leaving dunes where canoes once floated.

options.label: Follow the shore with the canoes
Turn to herding on the new grass

ai_israelite_rebuild_city_walls.title: Walls for the Holy City
ai_israelite_rebuild_city_walls.description: Raiders strip the countryside, and your engineers urge a full stone circuit with gun-ready gates around Jerusalem. The quarries and masons will cost you dearly.

options.label: Raise the full circuit of walls
Repair only the gates and towers

ai_israelite_safed_printing_press.title: A Press in Safed
ai_israelite_safed_printing_press.description: Scholars in the hills of Galilee ask for a Hebrew printing press of their own, so the works of their mystics need not travel to Venice to be set in type.

ai_israelite_tiberias_silk.title: Mulberries by the Lake
ai_israelite_tiberias_silk.description: A wealthy merchant family offers to rebuild ruined Tiberias, plant mulberry groves and weave silk, if you grant them the town and its taxes.

ai_israelite_messianic_claimant.title: A Messiah Proclaimed
ai_israelite_messianic_claimant.description: A charismatic preacher from Smyrna is hailed as the Messiah, and your subjects sell their homes to follow him. Foreign courts watch nervously how you will respond.

ai_israelite_french_at_the_coast.title: A General at Acre
ai_israelite_french_at_the_coast.description: A French army marches up the coast from Egypt and besieges the port of Acre. British ships offer guns and gunners, at a price.

options.label: Hold the coast with British help

ai_israelite_quarter_outside_walls.title: Beyond the Old Walls
ai_israelite_quarter_outside_walls.description: Jerusalem is crowded and plagued by disease. A philanthropist offers to build almshouses and a windmill outside the walls, but few dare sleep beyond the gates at night.

ai_israelite_farming_colonies.title: Settlers from the North
ai_israelite_farming_colonies.description: Young families fleeing pogroms arrive by ship at Jaffa, eager to drain swamps and found farming villages. They have little money and less experience.

options.label: Admit only a few each year

ai_israelite_jaffa_railway.title: Rails to Jerusalem
ai_israelite_jaffa_railway.description: Pilgrims spend days on the rough road from Jaffa to Jerusalem. You can lay a railway yourself, or let foreign investors build it for a concession.

options.label: Build the line with royal funds

ai_pacific_talasea_obsidian.title: Obsidian from Talasea
ai_pacific_talasea_obsidian.description: Canoes arrive carrying glassy obsidian from the volcanic shores of New Britain, far to the south. Every village wants its sharp blades, and the traders want shell valuables in return.

options.label: Send our own canoes to the source
Trade through middlemen at our shore

ai_pacific_dentate_stamped_pottery.title: The Stamped Faces
ai_pacific_dentate_stamped_pottery.description: Your potters press toothed stamps into wet clay, building intricate faces and bands that mark a household's lineage. The finest pots take weeks and the best clay lies far up the coast.

options.label: Honor the master potters with gifts
Make plain pots for daily cooking

ai_pacific_voyage_beyond_horizon.title: Beyond the Last Island
ai_pacific_voyage_beyond_horizon.description: Your navigators say the swells and birds point to land past the Solomons, where no one has ever lived. Outfitting double canoes would strip the village of its strongest paddlers.

options.label: Launch the voyage with pigs and taro
Keep the people close to home

ai_pacific_kuk_swamp_ditches.title: Choked Garden Ditches
ai_pacific_kuk_swamp_ditches.description: The drainage ditches that keep the swamp gardens dry are silting up after heavy rains. Clearing them means weeks of digging when families would rather plant.

options.label: Call every clan to dig together
Let each family clear its own plot

ai_pacific_cleared_slopes.title: The Bare Hillsides
ai_pacific_cleared_slopes.description: Generations of burning forest for taro and banana gardens have left the valley slopes open to grass, and soil now washes down into the swamp.

options.label: Forbid new clearing on the slopes
Mound and till the soil to hold it
Keep burning, the land is wide

ai_pacific_shells_from_coast.title: Shells from the Sea
ai_pacific_shells_from_coast.description: Marine shells passed hand to hand from the distant coast reach your valley, prized as bride wealth. Rival big men are bidding pigs to control the flow.

options.label: Seize the trail with your warriors
Let the shells go to others

ai_pacific_landfall_marianas.title: A New Shore
ai_pacific_landfall_marianas.description: After the longest open-sea crossing anyone remembers, your canoes have reached an uninhabited island of limestone and reef. The settlers must choose where to build first.

options.label: Settle by the lagoon to fish

ai_pacific_first_fiji_gardens.title: Gardens on Strange Soil
ai_pacific_first_fiji_gardens.description: The first settlers in these islands find fat birds and turtles easy to catch, but the yams and taro they brought struggle in the new ground.

options.label: Hunt freely while the game lasts
Put every hand to the gardens
Send canoes home for more cuttings

ai_sinic_salt_iron_monopoly.title: Salt and Iron
ai_sinic_salt_iron_monopoly.description: Your minister Guan Zhong proposes that the state take control of salt and iron. It would fill your treasury, but the merchant families of Qi will resent it.

options.label: Seize salt and iron for the state
Leave the trade to private merchants

ai_sinic_brushwood_and_gall.title: Brushwood and Gall
ai_sinic_brushwood_and_gall.description: Since your defeat by Wu, you sleep on brushwood and taste bitter gall each day. Your ministers counsel patience, while your officers crave revenge.

options.label: Rebuild quietly and send tribute to Wu
Strike Wu before you are ready

ai_sinic_weight_of_cauldrons.title: The Weight of Cauldrons
ai_sinic_weight_of_cauldrons.description: Your army stands at the Zhou border, and the royal envoy has come to greet you. You may ask him how heavy the nine sacred cauldrons of Zhou are.

options.label: Ask the weight of the cauldrons openly
Accept the envoy's rebuke and withdraw

ai_sinic_jixia_academy.title: Scholars at Jixia Gate
ai_sinic_jixia_academy.description: Thinkers from every state gather by the Jixia Gate of Linzi, debating rule and virtue. They ask for stipends and houses, and they criticize your court freely.

options.label: Keep the debaters at arm's length

ai_sinic_emperor_of_the_south.title: Two Emperors, One Sky
ai_sinic_emperor_of_the_south.description: The Han envoy Lu Jia returns with a letter from the new emperor. He asks you to give up your imperial title and rule Nanyue as a loyal king.

options.label: Renounce the title and submit in name

ai_sinic_seal_of_dian.title: The Golden Seal
ai_sinic_seal_of_dian.description: Han armies have crushed your neighbors and now stand at the shores of the Dian lake. Their general offers a golden seal and the title of king, if you submit.

options.label: Accept the Han seal and submit

ai_sinic_dujiangyan_weir.title: Taming the Min River
ai_sinic_dujiangyan_weir.description: Engineers propose splitting the Min River at Dujiangyan to end the floods and water the Chengdu plain. The work would take years of conscripted labor.

ai_sinic_fall_of_haojing.title: Haojing in Flames
ai_sinic_fall_of_haojing.description: Rong warriors, allied with the Marquis of Shen, have sacked Haojing and slain the king. The surviving nobles argue over rebuilding or moving the court east to Luoyi.

options.label: Move the court east to Luoyi

ai_nile_fall_of_soba.title: Funj Riders at Soba
ai_nile_fall_of_soba.description: Funj horsemen and Abdallab allies close in on the old Christian capital. Its churches are crumbling, and many townsfolk would rather bargain than fight.

ai_nile_portuguese_musketeers.title: Four Hundred Musketeers
ai_nile_portuguese_musketeers.description: Imam Ahmad's armies, armed with Ottoman matchlocks, have burned churches across the highlands. A small Portuguese force has landed at Massawa offering its guns, at a price.

options.label: Fight on from the mountain strongholds

ai_nile_portuguese_raids_coast.title: Sails Off the Coast
ai_nile_portuguese_raids_coast.description: Portuguese fleets have sacked Barawa and demand tribute from the Somali ports. Your merchants fear for the Indian Ocean trade that feeds the city.

ai_nile_jesuit_faith.title: The Jesuits at Court
ai_nile_jesuit_faith.description: Jesuit priests urge you to embrace the Roman faith and promise Portuguese friendship. The monks and nobles of the old church warn that the land will rise against you.

ai_nile_siwa_annexation.title: Troops Reach the Oasis
ai_nile_siwa_annexation.description: An Egyptian column with cannon has crossed the desert to Siwa demanding taxes on its dates. The oasis clans are split between paying and fighting.

ai_nile_cotton_boom.title: The Cotton Fever
ai_nile_cotton_boom.description: War in America has cut off its cotton, and European mills pay any price for Egyptian fibre. Landowners want to plough grain fields under for cotton.

ai_nile_mahdist_uprising.title: The Mahdi Calls
ai_nile_mahdist_uprising.description: A holy man in Kordofan proclaims himself the Mahdi and his followers have crushed an Egyptian army. Envoys arrive asking you to join his cause against the Turks.

ai_korea_muryeong_tomb.title: A Tomb of Southern Bricks
ai_korea_muryeong_tomb.description: Your late father's tomb could be built in the style of the Liang court, with lotus-stamped bricks and imported grave goods, or in the simpler stone of your ancestors.

ai_korea_move_to_sabi.title: Leaving the Cramped Capital
ai_korea_move_to_sabi.description: The hill fortress capital is safe but has no room to grow. The broad plain at Sabi on the river offers space and trade, but the old nobles resist the move.

ai_korea_monks_to_wa.title: Sutras for the Islands
ai_korea_monks_to_wa.description: Envoys from the Wa court across the sea ask for Buddhist images, sutras and monks. Their friendship could bring soldiers, but your best scholars may never return.

ai_korea_sui_invasion.title: The Sui Host Approaches
ai_korea_sui_invasion.description: A vast army from the Chinese dynasty marches on your walled capital. Your generals propose a feigned retreat to lure them deep, while ministers urge you to sue for terms.

options.label: Feign retreat and strike at the river
Offer tribute to end the war

ai_korea_restoration_army.title: Loyalists in the Hills
ai_korea_restoration_army.description: After the fall of your allies' capital, scattered loyalists hold mountain forts and beg for your support. Backing them angers the powerful Tang and Silla alliance.

ai_korea_khitan_demands.title: The Khitan Envoy's Demand
ai_korea_khitan_demands.description: A Khitan army camps on your northern frontier and demands you cut ties with the Song. A shrewd minister believes clever talks could even win you land.

ai_korea_island_refuge.title: Flight to the Island
ai_korea_island_refuge.description: Mongol horsemen ravage the peninsula but cannot cross the sea. Your court could withdraw to an island fortress, leaving farmers on the mainland to endure alone.

options.label: Move the court to the island

ai_korea_metal_type.title: Letters Cast in Metal
ai_korea_metal_type.description: Monks at a local temple have cast movable type in bronze to print Buddhist teachings. Expanding the work would spread learning, but it consumes precious copper.

ai_nile_semna_cataract_forts.title: Forts at the Cataract
ai_nile_semna_cataract_forts.description: Egyptian mud-brick fortresses now guard the Second Cataract, and a boundary stela forbids your boats to pass north except to trade.

options.label: Trade at their markets under their terms
Raid the river convoys from the desert
Build walls of your own upstream

ai_nile_western_deffufa.title: Raising the Great Deffufa
ai_nile_western_deffufa.description: Your priests ask that the great mud-brick temple at the heart of the city be raised higher, so that every caravan sees the might of your kings.

options.label: Raise it higher than ever before
Spend the bricks on granaries instead

ai_nile_hyksos_envoy.title: A Letter from Avaris
ai_nile_hyksos_envoy.description: The Hyksos king in the delta sends a messenger through the oases, urging you to strike Thebes from the south while he strikes from the north.

options.label: Feast the envoy but send no army

ai_nile_ships_from_kemet.title: Ships from the North
ai_nile_ships_from_kemet.description: Five great Egyptian ships beach on your shore, their envoys offering beads, axes and daggers for myrrh, ebony, gold and even living incense trees.

options.label: Sell resin but keep the trees

ai_nile_peru_nefer_shipyards.title: The Shipyards of Peru-nefer
ai_nile_peru_nefer_shipyards.description: The royal dockyard by the city wants Lebanese cedar and foreign craftsmen to build warships for campaigns up the Levantine coast.

options.label: Build river barges from local acacia

ai_nile_libu_sea_alliance.title: Allies from the Sea
ai_nile_libu_sea_alliance.description: Famine grips your tribes, and northern raiders from the sea offer to join you in seizing the fertile western delta, with your wives and herds following behind.

options.label: Lead the whole host into Egypt
Send only raiders, keep families home

ai_nile_tomb_builders_strike.title: The Rations Are Late
ai_nile_tomb_builders_strike.description: The royal tomb builders have laid down their tools and sat behind the temples, crying that their grain has not come for eighteen days.

options.label: Open temple granaries to pay them
Send the police to drive them back

ai_nile_libyan_chiefs_delta.title: Chiefs of the Ma
ai_nile_libyan_chiefs_delta.description: Your kin, settled for generations as soldiers in the delta, now hold whole towns, and one of their chiefs at Bubastis eyes the throne itself.

options.label: Back your kinsman's bid for the crown
Stay herders of the western desert

ai_monsoon_palembang_refinery_raid.title: Paratroopers Over the Refineries
ai_monsoon_palembang_refinery_raid.description: Enemy paratroopers are dropping on the oil refineries outside Palembang. Your engineers can still wreck the installations before they fall, but that will cost years of output.

ai_monsoon_balangay_boats_found.title: Ancient Boats in the Mud
ai_monsoon_balangay_boats_found.description: Diggers near Butuan have uncovered wooden plank boats centuries old, buried in the riverside mud. Developers want the land cleared; scholars want it protected.

ai_monsoon_lake_condah_land_return.title: The Lake Condah Lands
ai_monsoon_lake_condah_land_return.description: After long campaigning, the Gunditjmara are offered the return of the old mission lands near Lake Condah, where their ancestors built stone eel traps. Farmers nearby protest the transfer.

ai_monsoon_oc_eo_excavation.title: The Mound at Oc Eo
ai_monsoon_oc_eo_excavation.description: An archaeologist asks for laborers to dig a mound in the Mekong delta, where Roman coins and Indian seals point to a lost Funan port. The war needs those same hands.

options.label: Keep the men for the war effort

ai_monsoon_cham_refugees.title: Cham Refugees at the Border
ai_monsoon_cham_refugees.description: Cham Muslim families who survived years of persecution are fleeing across the border, seeking shelter. Taking them in strains your stores; turning them away shames you abroad.

options.label: Pass them to a third country

ai_monsoon_tondo_foreshore_relocation.title: The Tondo Foreshore
ai_monsoon_tondo_foreshore_relocation.description: Planners want to clear the crowded shanties on the Tondo foreshore for a port expansion. Organized residents vow to resist eviction.

options.label: Clear the shanties for the port

ai_monsoon_revolutionary_capital.title: A Capital in the Heartland
ai_monsoon_revolutionary_capital.description: With enemy troops holding the coast, the young republic moves its government inland to the old Mataram heartland around Yogyakarta. The city must feed and shelter it.

ai_monsoon_hung_temple_oath.title: Oath at the Hung Temple
ai_monsoon_hung_temple_oath.description: Soldiers marching home pause at the temple of the Hung Kings, where your leader tells them the founders built the country and they must keep it. Restoring the shrine would cost scarce funds.

ai_japan_tribute_to_jin.title: Envoys Across the Sea
ai_japan_tribute_to_jin.description: Your court prepares a mission to the new Jin court in China, as Himiko once sent envoys to Wei. Pearls, jade and fine cloth are expected as tribute.

options.label: Send rich tribute and many attendants

ai_japan_peninsula_iron.title: Iron From the Peninsula
ai_japan_peninsula_iron.description: Iron ingots from the southern Korean peninsula are prized by every chieftain in Wa. Traders demand high prices, and rivals compete for the same boats.

options.label: Send warriors to guard the sea lanes
Make do with stone and bronze

ai_japan_great_keyhole_mound.title: A Mound for the Queen
ai_japan_great_keyhole_mound.description: The priests of Makimuku call for a vast keyhole-shaped tomb to honor the late queen. It would take thousands of laborers through many seasons.

options.label: Raise the greatest mound ever seen
Keep the laborers in the rice fields

ai_japan_bronze_bells.title: The Bronze Bells
ai_japan_bronze_bells.description: Villages cast great bronze bells for rice rituals and bury them on hillsides. Your smiths say the metal would make far better spearheads and mirrors.

options.label: Cast larger bells for the rites

ai_japan_rice_reaches_north.title: Rice Reaches the North
ai_japan_rice_reaches_north.description: Newcomers from the south show your people how to flood paddies and grow rice. The harvests could be rich, but the cold summers often fail.

options.label: Keep to hunting, fishing and chestnuts

ai_japan_young_queen_tested.title: The Young Queen
ai_japan_young_queen_tested.description: After Himiko's death, a male king failed and the land fell into strife. Now you rule at thirteen, and the chieftains watch for weakness.

options.label: March warriors through the rebel villages

ai_japan_horses_from_south.title: Horses From the South
ai_japan_horses_from_south.description: Riders from the southern kingdoms bring horses, newly raised in pastures far to the south. Traders at Isawa offer foals in exchange for furs and hawks.

ai_japan_tombs_creep_north.title: Tombs on the Border
ai_japan_tombs_creep_north.description: Burial mounds of southern lords now rise ever closer to your valleys, and their settlers clear your hunting forests. Your elders demand an answer.

options.label: Raid the settlements before they grow

ai_americas_highland_outposts.title: Stone Outposts in the Valleys
ai_americas_highland_outposts.description: Your governors want walled administrative centers like Pikillacta, linked by roads, to store tribute and host feasts that bind distant valley lords to Huari.

options.label: Rely on feasts and gifts alone

ai_americas_great_house_timber.title: Timber for the Great House
ai_americas_great_house_timber.description: Extending the great house needs thousands of pine beams, carried on foot from mountains dozens of miles away across the dry canyon country.

options.label: Send work parties to the mountains

ai_americas_victory_over_calakmul.title: The Snake Kingdom Falters
ai_americas_victory_over_calakmul.description: Your warriors have beaten Calakmul's king in battle, ending decades of humiliation. Its allies waver, but pressing the war could exhaust Mutal.

ai_americas_war_with_hunza.title: War With the Zaque
ai_americas_war_with_hunza.description: The zaque of Hunza contests your hold on the highlands and their salt and emerald trade. Your nobles urge a campaign north.

ai_americas_shell_canal.title: A Canal Across the Island
ai_americas_shell_canal.description: Your engineers propose cutting a canoe canal across Pine Island so tribute and fish can move without the open Gulf, at great cost in labor.

ai_americas_strangers_tribute.title: The Strangers Demand Tribute
ai_americas_strangers_tribute.description: Bearded strangers from across the sea arrive in Jaragua demanding tribute. They have steel and horses, and they have already crushed other caciques.

ai_nile_high_dam_financing.title: Damming the Nile
ai_nile_high_dam_financing.description: Your engineers plan a great dam at Aswan to tame the flood and light your cities, but the West has withdrawn its loans and Moscow offers its own.

options.label: Delay and seek better Western terms

ai_nile_suez_nationalized.title: The Canal Company
ai_nile_suez_nationalized.description: The foreign company running the Suez Canal sends its profits abroad. Seizing it would thrill your people, but London and Paris are already massing ships.

options.label: Negotiate a larger share of tolls

ai_nile_gezira_cotton.title: Cotton Between Rivers
ai_nile_gezira_cotton.description: A new dam on the Blue Nile could water the plain near Soba for vast cotton fields, but the tenants would answer to the scheme's managers.

options.label: Fund the canals and cotton scheme
Leave the land to its farmers

ai_nile_italian_invasion.title: Fascist Columns Advance
ai_nile_italian_invasion.description: Italian armies with tanks and gas cross your northern border. Your warriors are brave but poorly armed, and the League of Nations debates slowly.

options.label: Appeal to the League in Geneva

ai_nile_desert_oil.title: Oil Beneath the Sand
ai_nile_desert_oil.description: Oil has just been struck in the desert to the west, and foreign companies now ask to drill around the Siwa oasis in return for generous royalties.

ai_nile_ogaden_war.title: The Ogaden Beckons
ai_nile_ogaden_war.description: Your neighbor is torn by revolution, and the herders of the Ogaden speak your tongue. Your generals swear the region can be taken before anyone intervenes.

options.label: Send the army across the border

ai_nile_halfa_resettlement.title: The Drowned Villages
ai_nile_halfa_resettlement.description: Rising waters behind the new dam downstream are flooding the old Nubian towns, and thousands of displaced families arrive near Kerma seeking land.

ai_nile_highland_famine.title: Famine in the Highlands
ai_nile_highland_famine.description: The rains have failed again and the northern provinces are starving while rebels hold the roads. Foreign cameras and aid agencies wait at your capital.

options.label: Open the provinces to foreign aid
Resettle the starving to the south

ai_steppe_karakum_canal.title: Canal Across the Karakum
ai_steppe_karakum_canal.description: Engineers propose diverting the Amu Darya through hundreds of kilometers of desert to water new cotton fields. The work is vast, and the river downstream will run thinner.

options.label: Dig the canal at full speed
Leave the river to its course

ai_steppe_aral_cotton_quota.title: White Gold, Shrinking Sea
ai_steppe_aral_cotton_quota.description: Planners raise the cotton quota for the lower Amu Darya, and the fields around Kath swallow ever more water. Fishermen on the Aral already see the shore retreating.

options.label: Meet the quota whatever the cost

ai_steppe_basmachi_revolt.title: Riders in the Hills
ai_steppe_basmachi_revolt.description: Basmachi bands strike from the valleys around Marakanda, cutting rail lines and rallying villages against the new Soviet order. Repression may fuel them; concessions may embolden them.

ai_steppe_virgin_lands.title: Plowing the Virgin Lands
ai_steppe_virgin_lands.description: Moscow calls for millions of hectares of steppe pasture to be turned into wheat, with volunteers arriving by the trainload. The soil is rich now, but the winds are strong.

ai_steppe_lop_nur_test.title: Fire at Lop Nur
ai_steppe_lop_nur_test.description: The dry lakebed near the ruins of Loulan is chosen for a nuclear test site. The program promises power and prestige, but the desert winds carry what the blasts leave behind.

ai_steppe_arkaim_reservoir.title: The Valley Before the Flood
ai_steppe_arkaim_reservoir.description: Archaeologists have found a ringed Bronze Age settlement at Arkaim, in a valley slated to become a reservoir for irrigation. The dam is nearly ready.

options.label: Cancel the reservoir, make a reserve

ai_steppe_mongolian_revolution.title: Red Partisans in Urga
ai_steppe_mongolian_revolution.description: Mongol revolutionaries backed by Soviet troops drive out the White Russian warlord and offer a new people's government. Their protection comes with Moscow's advisers.

options.label: Keep the Bogd Khan as figurehead

ai_steppe_afghan_war.title: Columns on the Amu Darya
ai_steppe_afghan_war.description: Soviet columns cross the river and pour south past Bactra, while mujahideen gather in the mountains with foreign weapons. The city must choose whom to shelter.

options.label: Garrison the city for the Soviets

ai_japan_flame_pottery.title: Flames of Clay
ai_japan_flame_pottery.description: The potters of Makimuku shape vessels with rims like leaping fire. Each takes days to make, and the hunters ask why clay needs such work.

options.label: Honor the potters and feed their craft
Order plain pots for storing nuts

ai_japan_chestnut_groves.title: The Chestnut Groves
ai_japan_chestnut_groves.description: Your people have learned that chestnut trees near the village give more each autumn if the forest around them is cleared. But the deer live in that forest.

options.label: Clear the woods and tend the groves
Keep the forest for the hunt

ai_japan_obsidian_crossing.title: Black Glass Across Water
ai_japan_obsidian_crossing.description: The sharpest obsidian comes from an island far across the sea, reached only by dugout canoe. Some of your young men are willing to paddle there, Iyo.

options.label: Send the canoes across the sea
Buy it from the coastal villages

ai_japan_green_jade.title: Green Stone of Itoigawa
ai_japan_green_jade.description: Traders bring polished green jade from a river in the west, hard to work and rare. The elders of Isawa want it to mark who leads.

options.label: Trade furs for jade for the elders

ai_japan_rising_sea.title: The Sea Comes Inland
ai_japan_rising_sea.description: The sea has crept up the valleys, drowning old camps and making shallow bays rich with clams. Your people must choose where to live.

options.label: Move up to the dry terraces
Settle the shores and gather shellfish

ai_japan_clay_figures.title: The Broken Figures
ai_japan_clay_figures.description: The healers shape small clay figures with wide eyes, then break them to carry away sickness. They ask you, Aterui, for food to fund the rites.

ai_japan_great_pillars.title: Pillars of Chestnut
ai_japan_great_pillars.description: The village has grown large, and some want to raise a hall on six giant chestnut trunks, seen from far off. Felling and hauling them will take every hand.

ai_japan_bubble_burst.title: The Bubble Bursts
ai_japan_bubble_burst.description: Land and stock prices that seemed eternal collapse together. Banks of the Yamatai sit on loans that will never be repaid.

options.label: Force banks to write off bad loans
Quietly prop up the zombie banks

ai_japan_hanshin_earthquake.title: The Great Hanshin Earthquake
ai_japan_hanshin_earthquake.description: Before dawn a quake levels much of the Kansai coast near Makimuku. Volunteers pour in faster than the slow official relief.

options.label: Fund a full rebuild to new codes
Lean on volunteers and local funds

ai_japan_tohoku_tsunami.title: Wave Over Tohoku
ai_japan_tohoku_tsunami.description: A great earthquake and tsunami strike the northeast coast near Isawa, and a nuclear plant to the south melts down. The nation doubts its reactors.

ai_japan_emptying_villages.title: The Emptying Villages
ai_japan_emptying_villages.description: Young Emishi leave the northern valleys for the capital, and schools close one by one. Whole villages are left to the elderly.

ai_japan_asteroid_probe.title: A Probe to an Asteroid
ai_japan_asteroid_probe.description: Your space scientists propose a small craft to land on an asteroid and return a sample. Nobody has ever done it, and budgets are tight.

ai_japan_three_arrows.title: Three Arrows of Reform
ai_japan_three_arrows.description: Advisors urge Iyo to end two decades of deflation with cheap money, heavy spending and structural reform at once.

ai_japan_subway_cult_attack.title: Gas in the Subway
ai_japan_subway_cult_attack.description: A doomsday cult releases nerve gas on crowded morning trains. The Yamatai demand answers, but many fear police power over religion.

options.label: Prosecute the cult, protect religious freedom

ai_japan_mobile_internet.title: Internet in Every Pocket
ai_japan_mobile_internet.description: A phone carrier offers mail and web pages on handsets years ahead of the world. Iyo must choose a domestic standard or a global one.

ai_maghreb_barqa_tribute_treaty.title: Terms From Amr's Army
ai_maghreb_barqa_tribute_treaty.description: Arab horsemen under Amr ibn al-As have overrun Barqa. Their envoys offer peace for a yearly tribute of thousands of dinars, or war against your crumbling walls.

options.label: Accept the tribute and keep your towns
Man the old walls and resist

ai_maghreb_foggara_tunnels_dry.title: The Foggaras Run Dry
ai_maghreb_foggara_tunnels_dry.description: The underground water channels that fed Garama's fields yield less each year, and Arab raiders under Uqba ibn Nafi now press the oases.

options.label: Dig deeper channels with forced labor
Abandon outer fields and trade for grain

ai_maghreb_idris_at_volubilis.title: A Fugitive Sharif Arrives
ai_maghreb_idris_at_volubilis.description: Idris, a descendant of the Prophet fleeing the Abbasids, reaches Volubilis. The Awraba Berbers want to proclaim him imam, which will anger Baghdad.

options.label: Proclaim Idris and rally the tribes
Shelter him quietly without a title
Send him away to avoid trouble

ai_maghreb_banu_hilal_arrive.title: The Banu Hilal Come West
ai_maghreb_banu_hilal_arrive.description: Bedouin tribes loosed by the Fatimids pour across Ifriqiya, grazing herds over farmland and plundering towns around Constantine.

options.label: Fight them in the open plains

ai_maghreb_merchant_quarter.title: The Merchants' Town
ai_maghreb_merchant_quarter.description: Muslim traders from the north have built a stone town with twelve mosques beside your royal city. They ask for lower duties on salt and gold.

options.label: Lower the duties to draw more caravans
Keep the king's share of every nugget

ai_maghreb_almoravid_pressure.title: Veiled Warriors From Sahara
ai_maghreb_almoravid_pressure.description: The Almoravids have taken Awdaghust and now threaten your northern trade routes, demanding that your court embrace their strict Islam.

options.label: Convert the court and make peace
Raise the archers and hold the Sahel

ai_maghreb_hummay_conversion.title: The Mai Takes Islam
ai_maghreb_hummay_conversion.description: Scholars at court urge your mai to embrace Islam openly, opening ties to Egypt and the Maghreb, while the old shrines' keepers warn of unrest.

ai_maghreb_old_mound_abandoned.title: Leaving the Old Mound
ai_maghreb_old_mound_abandoned.description: Families are deserting the ancient mound for the new Muslim town of Djenné nearby, where river trade and scholars now gather.

options.label: Move the market to the new town
Hold the old town with its ancestral rites

ai_levant_magan_copper_ships.title: Copper for Sumer
ai_levant_magan_copper_ships.description: Reed boats from the rivers of Sumer beach on your shore, asking for the copper smelted in your mountains and offering grain, wool and oil.

options.label: Open the mines to the foreign ships
Sell only small loads at high prices

ai_levant_manium_akkad.title: The King of Akkad
ai_levant_manium_akkad.description: The armies of Akkad cross the sea, and their king boasts he will take your copper mountains and carry your stone home as a trophy.

options.label: Retreat to the mountains and wait
Send tribute and keep your throne

ai_levant_bat_stone_towers.title: The Round Towers
ai_levant_bat_stone_towers.description: Your elders want great round towers of cut stone raised beside the wells and palm groves, a work that will take many seasons of labor.

options.label: Raise the towers by the wells
Keep the hands in the date groves

ai_levant_van_obsidian.title: Black Glass of Van
ai_levant_van_obsidian.description: The volcano above the great lake yields black glass that cuts sharper than any flint, and traders from distant villages come to bargain for it.

options.label: Guard the quarries and set a price
Trade it freely along the valleys

ai_levant_kura_araxes_hearths.title: Hearths of the Highland
ai_levant_kura_araxes_hearths.description: Herders with burnished black pottery and round houses spread through your valleys, moving flocks between summer pastures and winter villages.

options.label: Join them on the high pastures

ai_levant_colchis_arsenic_copper.title: The Hard Copper
ai_levant_colchis_arsenic_copper.description: Your smiths find that certain mountain ores make copper harder and brighter, but the fumes of the furnace sicken the men who tend it.

options.label: Fire the furnaces day and night
Work the ore only in small batches

ai_levant_ugarit_coastal_village.title: Mound by the Sea
ai_levant_ugarit_coastal_village.description: Your village on its mound by the harbor has grown crowded, and families argue whether to clear new fields inland or take to the sea for fish.

options.label: Clear new fields in the hills
Build boats and fish the coast

ai_levant_saba_flood_channels.title: Taming the Flash Floods
ai_levant_saba_flood_channels.description: Rare rains send torrents roaring down the wadis, and your farmers propose earthen walls and channels to spread the water over the fields.

options.label: Dig the channels across the wadi
Keep to herding and wild grazing

ai_nile_longinus_mission.title: The Missionary From Alexandria
ai_nile_longinus_mission.description: A bishop named Longinus has crossed the deserts to your court, offering baptism and ties to the Miaphysite church of Alexandria. Your priests of the old gods grumble.

options.label: Accept baptism for the royal house
Welcome him but keep the old rites
Send him back down the Nile

ai_nile_baqt_treaty.title: Terms at the Cataract
ai_nile_baqt_treaty.description: Arab armies from Egypt besieged Dongola and failed to break it. Their commander now proposes a pact: yearly tribute of captives in exchange for grain, cloth and peace.

options.label: Sign the pact and send the captives

ai_nile_memphis_quarry.title: Stones of the Old Capital
ai_nile_memphis_quarry.description: Builders of the new capital across the river want the ancient temples of Men-nefer for cut stone. The ruins are cheap to haul and endless.

options.label: Let the masons strip the ruins
Open new quarries in the hills

ai_nile_great_calamity.title: The Nile Fails Again
ai_nile_great_calamity.description: For the third year the flood has stayed low. Granaries are emptying, bread prices soar, and unpaid soldiers loot the markets of the capital.

options.label: Empty the treasury to buy grain
Let the provinces fend for themselves

ai_nile_shali_fortress.title: A Fortress of Salt Mud
ai_nile_shali_fortress.description: Desert raiders have thinned the families of Siwa to a few hundred. Elders propose abandoning the scattered villages for one walled hill town built of salt and mud.

ai_nile_rock_churches.title: Churches Carved From Rock
ai_nile_rock_churches.description: Your king dreams of a new Jerusalem in the highlands, with churches hewn whole from the living rock. It will take thousands of workers for decades.

ai_nile_persian_merchants.title: Merchants From Across the Sea
ai_nile_persian_merchants.description: Traders from Persia and Arabia ask to settle in Opone, build a mosque and trade cloth for gum and ivory. Local clans fear losing their grip on the harbor.

options.label: Grant them a quarter by the harbor

ai_nile_nomads_at_soba.title: Herders at the Gates
ai_nile_nomads_at_soba.description: Arab herding clans push their camels into the pastures around Soba, and the old churches stand half empty. Some chiefs offer service in return for grazing rights.

options.label: Drive them from the river lands
Tax their herds and look away

ai_mesopotamia_ugarit_palace_visit.title: A King Asks to Visit
ai_mesopotamia_ugarit_palace_visit.description: The king of Ugarit has heard of your great palace at Mari and asks, through the court of Aleppo, to come and see it with his own eyes.

options.label: Host him with a lavish royal welcome

ai_mesopotamia_elamite_tin_shipment.title: Tin From the East
ai_mesopotamia_elamite_tin_shipment.description: Caravans have brought Elamite tin to Mari, and kings of the west wait to see how you will share it out among them.

options.label: Sell it at the highest price
Keep it for your own bronze smiths

ai_mesopotamia_stele_to_susa.title: Trophies of Babylonia
ai_mesopotamia_stele_to_susa.description: Your armies have sacked the cities of Babylonia, and among the spoils stand ancient stelae of famous kings. Carrying them home will take men and carts.

ai_mesopotamia_magan_copper_route.title: Copper From Magan
ai_mesopotamia_magan_copper_route.description: Merchants of Ur sail to Dilmun to buy copper shipped from Magan, but they complain of poor quality ingots and threaten to take their silver elsewhere.

ai_mesopotamia_temple_of_inzak.title: The Sacred Spring
ai_mesopotamia_temple_of_inzak.description: Priests of Inzak ask for a new stone temple beside the freshwater spring that sailors believe makes Dilmun blessed.

options.label: Build the temple in dressed stone
Spend the stone on harbor walls

ai_mesopotamia_walls_of_kish.title: The Walls of Kish
ai_mesopotamia_walls_of_kish.description: Revolts are spreading through the southern cities, and the old walls of Kish stand crumbling. Rebuilding them would demand a season of forced labor.

options.label: Rebuild the walls with corvée labor

ai_mesopotamia_new_holy_city.title: A City for the Gods
ai_mesopotamia_new_holy_city.description: Your architects propose a new holy city with a towering ziggurat, uniting the gods of the highlands and the lowlands in one sacred place.

options.label: Honor the old shrines of Susa

ai_mesopotamia_akkadian_letters.title: The Language of Kings
ai_mesopotamia_akkadian_letters.description: From Egypt to Hatti, great kings now write to one another in Akkadian on clay tablets, and every court needs scribes trained in your tongue.

options.label: Charge foreigners to train at home

ai_europe_sirmium_tribute.title: Gold From Constantinople
ai_europe_sirmium_tribute.description: Imperial envoys offer you yearly gold if your horsemen leave the Danube frontier in peace. Your warriors want Sirmium, the fortress city that guards the river crossing.

ai_europe_columba_at_gates.title: A Monk at Your Gate
ai_europe_columba_at_gates.description: An Irish abbot from Iona stands before your fortress asking leave to preach among your people. Your druids warn that his god will not share your hall.

options.label: Open the gates and hear him

ai_europe_karmsund_toll.title: The Northern Way
ai_europe_karmsund_toll.description: Every ship sailing the coast must pass through the narrow Karmsund strait beneath your hall. Merchants grumble at the toll, and some speak of hiring raiders to break it.

options.label: Raise the toll on passing ships
Lower it to draw more traders
Build longships to guard the strait

ai_europe_skara_bishopric.title: A Bishop for Skara
ai_europe_skara_bishopric.description: Missionaries from the Danish and English churches ask to seat a bishop in Skara, bringing scribes and Latin learning. Many chieftains still sacrifice at the old groves.

options.label: Let them preach but grant nothing

ai_europe_strangford_longships.title: Longships on the Lough
ai_europe_strangford_longships.description: Norse crews have begun wintering on the loughs of your coast instead of sailing home. They raid by spring and trade silver by summer.

options.label: Gather the warbands and drive them out

ai_europe_andalusian_exiles.title: Exiles From Al-Andalus
ai_europe_andalusian_exiles.description: A fleet of Andalusian exiles has landed on Crete and is fortifying a camp near the old ruins of Knossos. The imperial governor sends no help.

ai_europe_venetian_protection.title: The Lion of Saint Mark
ai_europe_venetian_protection.description: With Ottoman raiders pressing from the east, Venice offers to garrison Scodra and its citadel in return for control of the city and its river trade.

options.label: Hold Scodra with your own men

ai_europe_orvieto_cathedral.title: A Cathedral on the Rock
ai_europe_orvieto_cathedral.description: The bishop and the pope's court ask you to raise a great cathedral atop your volcanic crag. Masons from Siena are ready, but the work will take generations.

ai_japan_arquebus_arrival.title: Guns from the South
ai_japan_arquebus_arrival.description: Portuguese traders blown off course have sold two arquebuses to a southern lord, and smiths across the islands are eager to learn how they are made.

ai_japan_jesuit_mission.title: The Black-Robed Priests
ai_japan_jesuit_mission.description: Jesuit missionaries ask to preach in your lands. Their presence draws Portuguese ships and silk, but converts may come to obey a distant faith before you.

ai_japan_sword_hunt.title: The Sword Hunt
ai_japan_sword_hunt.description: Following the regent's example, your officials propose collecting every sword and gun held by the farmers around Makimuku, fixing them to the soil for good.

ai_japan_pacific_embassy.title: An Embassy Across Oceans
ai_japan_pacific_embassy.description: A northern lord has built a galleon to carry envoys to New Spain and Rome. Isawa's merchants urge you to send men of your own aboard.

ai_japan_salmon_for_rice.title: Less Rice for Salmon
ai_japan_salmon_for_rice.description: Southern traders now give far less rice for each bale of salmon and furs, and the northern chiefs talk openly of war against them.

options.label: Back the chiefs against the traders

ai_japan_dutch_anatomy.title: A Dutch Anatomy Book
ai_japan_dutch_anatomy.description: Physicians who watched a dissection found a Dutch anatomy text more accurate than the Chinese classics, and they ask your support to translate it.

ai_japan_tenmei_famine.title: Ash and Cold Summers
ai_japan_tenmei_famine.description: Volcanic ash and failed harvests have left the north starving, and crowds gather outside Isawa's rice warehouses demanding grain.

options.label: Sell the rice at famine prices

ai_japan_black_ships.title: The Black Ships Return
ai_japan_black_ships.description: American steam warships have returned to demand open ports and coal for their fleet. Their guns outrange anything on your shores.

ai_indic_harappa_mounds.title: Bricks Beneath Harappa
ai_indic_harappa_mounds.description: Diggers at the mounds of Harappa find seals in an unknown script, but railway contractors still haul the ancient bricks away as track ballast.

ai_indic_bengal_partition.title: Bengal Cut in Two
ai_indic_bengal_partition.description: The province of Bengal is split along religious lines, and Bengalis answer with a boycott of foreign cloth and mass protests in the streets.

ai_indic_digboi_refinery.title: Oil at Digboi
ai_indic_digboi_refinery.description: Crude oil seeps from the jungle floor near Digboi in Assam, and engineers propose a refinery deep in the hills.

options.label: Grant a foreign company the concession

ai_indic_temple_entry.title: The Temple Doors Open
ai_indic_temple_entry.description: Reformers lead Dalit worshippers into the great Meenakshi temple of Madurai, and the priests threaten to abandon the shrine in protest.

ai_indic_partition_refugees.title: Columns Across the Border
ai_indic_partition_refugees.description: A new border slices through Punjab, and millions flee in both directions while trains arrive full of the dead.

ai_indic_bihar_earthquake.title: The Earth Splits Bihar
ai_indic_bihar_earthquake.description: A great earthquake levels towns across Bihar, burying fields under sand and leaving whole districts homeless in the winter cold.

ai_indic_taxila_finds.title: Treasures of Taxila
ai_indic_taxila_finds.description: Excavators at Takshashila unearth Gandharan sculpture and coins, and foreign collectors are already offering generous prices for the finest pieces.

ai_indic_odia_province.title: A Province for Odia
ai_indic_odia_province.description: Odia speakers, scattered among neighboring provinces, demand a land of their own drawn around their language and the old heart of Kalinga.

ai_sinic_boxer_uprising.title: The Boxers Rise
ai_sinic_boxer_uprising.description: Bands of Boxers from the Shandong countryside tear up railways and attack missionaries, vowing to drive out the foreigners. Foreign legations demand you crush them.

options.label: Back the Boxers against the foreigners

ai_sinic_wuchang_uprising.title: Mutiny at Wuchang
ai_sinic_wuchang_uprising.description: A bomb goes off by accident in a revolutionary cell in Hubei, and the New Army garrison rises rather than face arrest. Province after province may follow.

options.label: Send loyal troops to retake the city
Wait and negotiate with both sides

ai_sinic_whampoa_academy.title: An Academy at Whampoa
ai_sinic_whampoa_academy.description: Soviet advisers offer money, rifles and instructors to found a military academy on an island near Guangzhou, training officers loyal to the party rather than to warlords.

ai_sinic_yinxu_excavation.title: Digging the Shang Capital
ai_sinic_yinxu_excavation.description: Scholars of the Academia Sinica ask to excavate the fields near Anyang, where farmers have long sold inscribed oracle bones to dealers. Looters are digging already.

ai_sinic_xian_incident.title: Generals Seize the Leader
ai_sinic_xian_incident.description: Your own generals at Xi'an detain the national leader and demand he stop fighting the Communists and turn against the Japanese invaders.

ai_sinic_burma_road.title: A Road to Burma
ai_sinic_burma_road.description: With the coast lost to Japan, you need a lifeline through the Yunnan mountains to British Burma. Hundreds of thousands of laborers could cut it by hand.

options.label: Conscript laborers to build the road

ai_sinic_datong_school.title: Rebels at the School
ai_sinic_datong_school.description: Officials report that the Datong school in Shaoxing, led by the poet Qiu Jin, is drilling students and hiding rifles for an uprising.

options.label: Raid the school and arrest her

ai_sinic_special_economic_zone.title: A Special Economic Zone
ai_sinic_special_economic_zone.description: Reformers propose opening a fishing town on the Hong Kong border to foreign capital, low taxes and private factories, as an experiment for the whole south.

options.label: Open the zone to foreign investors

ai_americas_oil_expropriation.title: The Oil Companies Defy Us
ai_americas_oil_expropriation.description: Foreign oil companies refuse a court order to raise their workers' wages. The strikers and the whole country now wait to see what you will do.

ai_americas_chaco_border_war.title: War in the Chaco
ai_americas_chaco_border_war.description: Rumors of oil beneath the dry Gran Chaco have turned a border quarrel into open war. Your highland conscripts are dying of thirst in the lowland scrub.

options.label: Send more conscripts to the front

ai_americas_rubber_bust.title: The Rubber Bubble Bursts
ai_americas_rubber_bust.description: Cheap rubber from Asian plantations has crashed the price of wild Amazon latex. The tappers and river merchants of Marajó face ruin.

options.label: Turn the land to cattle ranching

ai_americas_marines_land.title: Marines in the Harbor
ai_americas_marines_land.description: After a president is torn apart by a mob, foreign marines land and seize the customs houses. Peasant rebels in the hills call on you to resist.

options.label: Arm the rebels in the hills

ai_americas_arctic_radar_line.title: Radar on the Ice
ai_americas_arctic_radar_line.description: A powerful southern ally wants to build early warning radar stations across your Arctic coast. The work brings wages, but also strangers and noise to the hunting grounds.

ai_americas_fishmeal_boom.title: The Anchovy Fleet
ai_americas_fishmeal_boom.description: Fishmeal from the cold coastal current has made your ports among the busiest fisheries on Earth. Old fishermen warn that a warm El Niño year could empty the sea.

ai_americas_desert_dam.title: A Dam for the Desert
ai_americas_desert_dam.description: Engineers propose a great masonry dam upriver to store floodwater for the desert fields. The farmers who dig and share the old canals fear losing their say.

ai_americas_land_reform.title: The Land to Those Who Work It
ai_americas_land_reform.description: Your officers demand that the great haciendas be broken up and handed to the peasant communities. The estate owners and their foreign buyers threaten to pull their money.

ai_westafrica_bronze_casting_masters.title: The Casters of Heads
ai_westafrica_bronze_casting_masters.description: Your casters can shape lifelike heads of kings in copper alloy, but the metal must come north across the desert through costly trade routes.

options.label: Buy copper for royal portrait heads
Cast in clay and save the metal

ai_westafrica_glass_bead_furnaces.title: Furnaces of Blue Beads
ai_westafrica_glass_bead_furnaces.description: Your glassmakers melt local sand into prized blue beads that neighbors pay dearly for, but the furnaces devour wood and labor.

options.label: Keep beads for royal regalia only
Share the craft with allied towns

ai_westafrica_mande_gold_traders.title: Traders From the North
ai_westafrica_mande_gold_traders.description: Mande merchants arrive seeking gold from your forest fields, offering cloth, salt and brass in return, and they ask to settle in your town.

options.label: Grant them a quarter of the town
Trade only at the market gates

ai_westafrica_gold_dust_monopoly.title: The King's Share of Gold
ai_westafrica_gold_dust_monopoly.description: Your miners bring up nuggets as well as dust. You may claim every nugget for the throne, but the miners grumble at losing their best finds.

options.label: Claim all nuggets for the stool
Let miners keep a fair portion

ai_westafrica_copper_cross_currency.title: Crosses of Copper
ai_westafrica_copper_cross_currency.description: Small copper crosses from the southern mines now pass from hand to hand as wealth along the Lualaba lakes, and chiefs hoard them as bride wealth.

ai_westafrica_sacred_kingship_rites.title: The Rites of Kingship
ai_westafrica_sacred_kingship_rites.description: Elders insist the new king must eat apart and never be seen drinking, as befits sacred royal blood. The old chiefs see it as arrogance.

options.label: Rule as one among the chiefs

ai_westafrica_foreign_hunter_suitor.title: A Hunter From Afar
ai_westafrica_foreign_hunter_suitor.description: A skilled Luba hunter seeks your hand and brings new ways of rule. Your brothers warn that a foreign husband will steal the royal bracelet.

ai_westafrica_kongo_tribute_demand.title: Tribute to Kongo
ai_westafrica_kongo_tribute_demand.description: The mighty king of Kongo to the north demands tribute of iron tools and slaves, as from a vassal. Refusal may bring his armies.

ai_mesopotamia_zanj_rising.title: Revolt in the Salt Marshes
ai_mesopotamia_zanj_rising.description: Enslaved laborers who scrape salt crusts from the southern marshes have risen in revolt, and their leader promises freedom to all who join him.

options.label: Send the army into the marshes

ai_mesopotamia_paper_mill.title: The Secret of Paper
ai_mesopotamia_paper_mill.description: Craftsmen from the east offer to build a paper mill in your city, promising cheap sheets that could replace costly parchment and papyrus.

options.label: Fund the mill and its workshops
Buy paper from eastern traders instead

ai_mesopotamia_qarmatian_preachers.title: Preachers of a New Order
ai_mesopotamia_qarmatian_preachers.description: Qarmatian missionaries win followers among the villages and oases of the Gulf coast, preaching shared property and defiance of distant caliphs.

options.label: Make an alliance with their leaders

ai_mesopotamia_pearl_season.title: The Pearl Season
ai_mesopotamia_pearl_season.description: The summer diving season begins over the oyster banks, and merchants from Basra and India wait in your harbor for the finest pearls.

ai_mesopotamia_daylamite_mercenaries.title: Soldiers From the Mountains
ai_mesopotamia_daylamite_mercenaries.description: Daylamite foot soldiers, hardy men from the Caspian highlands, offer you their spears, but their captains are ambitious and have seized provinces before.

ai_mesopotamia_mongol_demand.title: The Khan Demands Submission
ai_mesopotamia_mongol_demand.description: Envoys of the Mongol prince Hulagu arrive with a letter: open your gates and pay tribute, or share the fate of the cities already burned.

ai_mesopotamia_timur_approaches.title: The Lame Conqueror Approaches
ai_mesopotamia_timur_approaches.description: Timur's army moves into Syria, and refugees speak of towers built from skulls outside towns that resisted him.

options.label: Send gifts and craftsmen as tribute
Gather the levies and hold the river

ai_nile_oracle_of_amun.title: A Conqueror at the Oracle
ai_nile_oracle_of_amun.description: A young Macedonian king crosses the desert to Siwa and asks the priests of Amun to greet him as the god's own son.

options.label: Hail him as the son of Amun

ai_nile_kings_from_the_south.title: Kings from the South
ai_nile_kings_from_the_south.description: A Kushite king marches down the Nile claiming to restore the true worship of Amun, and the princes of the delta are divided.

options.label: Rally the delta princes to resist

ai_nile_canal_to_the_red_sea.title: The Canal to the Sea
ai_nile_canal_to_the_red_sea.description: The Persian governor orders the old canal from the Nile to the Red Sea dug out again, demanding laborers and grain from your city.

ai_nile_sabaean_masons.title: Masons from Saba
ai_nile_sabaean_masons.description: Stoneworkers from across the Red Sea offer to raise a temple of fitted ashlar to Almaqah, finer than anything your highlands have seen.

options.label: Hire them for a great temple

ai_nile_ships_at_opone.title: Ships from Egypt
ai_nile_ships_at_opone.description: Greek merchants sailing from Roman Egypt anchor at Opone, eager for cinnamon and tortoiseshell, and ask to trade freely without your agents.

ai_nile_furnaces_of_the_south.title: Furnaces of the South
ai_nile_furnaces_of_the_south.description: Your smiths smelt iron day and night, but the furnaces devour the acacia groves that shade the riverbanks and feed the herds.

options.label: Cut the groves to feed the furnaces

ai_nile_aksum_on_the_atbara.title: Aksum on the River
ai_nile_aksum_on_the_atbara.description: The king of Aksum leads his army down to the meeting of the rivers, burning Noba villages and demanding tribute.

ai_nile_greeks_seek_land.title: Settlers from Thera
ai_nile_greeks_seek_land.description: Greek settlers camped on the coast ask your chiefs to guide them inland to a fertile plateau with a flowing spring.

options.label: Drive them back to the sea

ai_levant_rock_tombs_tourism.title: The Tombs Draw Visitors
ai_levant_rock_tombs_tourism.description: The carved tombs of Hegra have won world heritage status, and tour operators want hotels, roads and an airport beside them.

ai_levant_offshore_oil_contract.title: Contract of the Century
ai_levant_offshore_oil_contract.description: Foreign oil companies offer to develop the deep Caspian fields in exchange for a long share of the profits.

ai_levant_black_sea_terminal.title: A Pipeline to the Sea
ai_levant_black_sea_terminal.description: A pipeline from the Caspian could end at the port of Phasis, bringing transit fees and the anger of a powerful northern neighbor.

ai_levant_quake_building_codes.title: After the Earthquake
ai_levant_quake_building_codes.description: A great earthquake has struck western Anatolia, and the rubble reveals concrete that builders cut with sand and bribes.

options.label: Enforce strict codes and prosecute builders

ai_levant_falling_water_table.title: The Wells Run Dry
ai_levant_falling_water_table.description: Pumps drilled for thirsty qat fields are draining the aquifer under Maryab faster than the rains can refill it.

options.label: Fund drip irrigation and dam repairs

ai_levant_drought_exodus.title: Drought on the Plains
ai_levant_drought_exodus.description: A third dry year has withered the wheat, and farming families pour into the coastal cities looking for work.

ai_levant_jobs_for_citizens.title: Young Men Want Jobs
ai_levant_jobs_for_citizens.description: Protesters in the ports demand work, while foreign laborers fill most private jobs at lower wages.

ai_levant_coastal_nuclear_plant.title: A Reactor by the Sea
ai_levant_coastal_nuclear_plant.description: A foreign partner offers to build a nuclear power plant on the peninsula of Sinope, ending costly fuel imports.

ai_eastafrica_punt_incense_ships.title: Ships From the North
ai_eastafrica_punt_incense_ships.description: Foreign sailors from a great river kingdom beach their ships on your coast, seeking myrrh trees, incense, ebony and live baboons.

options.label: Trade freely for their gold and goods
Demand gifts before they reach the groves

ai_eastafrica_myrrh_tree_saplings.title: Selling the Living Trees
ai_eastafrica_myrrh_tree_saplings.description: The northern traders now ask not for resin but for whole myrrh saplings in baskets, to plant in their own temple gardens.

options.label: Sell the saplings at a high price
Sell only resin, keep the trees

ai_eastafrica_obsidian_quarry.title: The Black Glass Quarry
ai_eastafrica_obsidian_quarry.description: Herders travel far to the volcanic flows of the Rift for obsidian, the sharpest blade stone known, and rival bands now camp at the outcrops.

options.label: Share the outcrop for cattle tribute

ai_eastafrica_herders_from_north.title: Herders on the Grasslands
ai_eastafrica_herders_from_north.description: Cattle herders moving south reach the lake country, and their herds graze the same lands your foragers and fishers have long used.

options.label: Trade fish for milk and hides

ai_eastafrica_painted_hills.title: The Hills That Speak
ai_eastafrica_painted_hills.description: Elders say the spirits dwell in the painted rock faces, and a new generation wishes to add its own eland and rhino to the cliffs.

options.label: Gather ochre and bless the painters

ai_eastafrica_dry_waterholes.title: The Waterholes Fail
ai_eastafrica_dry_waterholes.description: The rains have not come for two seasons, the pans are cracked, and the game has scattered beyond the known hunting grounds.

options.label: Split into small bands and follow game
Dig deep and store water in shells

ai_eastafrica_limpopo_floodplain.title: The River Rises
ai_eastafrica_limpopo_floodplain.description: The Limpopo spills across its floodplain, leaving rich silt behind but drowning camps and driving animals to the sandstone hills.

options.label: Move the camps onto the hilltop
Stay low and gather the new growth

ai_eastafrica_monsoon_fishers.title: Fishers of the Reef
ai_eastafrica_monsoon_fishers.description: The seasonal winds bring great shoals to the reef, but rival fishing families quarrel over who may cast nets in the best channels.

options.label: Let the strongest families take them

ai_indic_harsha_vengeance.title: Harsha Seeks Vengeance
ai_indic_harsha_vengeance.description: You have struck down the king of Thanesar. His younger brother Harsha now gathers a great army to avenge him, allied with Kamarupa on your eastern flank.

ai_indic_pilgrim_summons.title: The Chinese Pilgrim
ai_indic_pilgrim_summons.description: A renowned Chinese monk studying at Nalanda could grace your court. Harsha also wants him, and a forceful summons may offend your powerful ally.

options.label: Demand the monk come at once

ai_indic_astronomical_compendium.title: Tables of the Heavens
ai_indic_astronomical_compendium.description: Astronomers of Ujjayini in the circle of Varahamihira ask for funds to compile new planetary tables and calendar rules for the realm.

options.label: Use them only for war omens

ai_indic_arab_war_horses.title: Horses That Die
ai_indic_arab_war_horses.description: Arab merchants sell you war horses at enormous prices, yet the animals rarely survive a year in your climate, forcing you to buy again and again.

ai_indic_chola_invasion.title: The Cholas Cross Over
ai_indic_chola_invasion.description: Chola armies sent by Rajaraja have crossed the strait, and your ancient capital lies exposed on the open northern plain.

ai_indic_ghaznavid_raids.title: Mahmud at the Passes
ai_indic_ghaznavid_raids.description: Mahmud of Ghazni leads mounted archers through the mountain passes toward Purushapura, plundering temples and towns as he advances.

options.label: Call on neighboring kings for aid

ai_indic_debal_ultimatum.title: Ultimatum at Debal
ai_indic_debal_ultimatum.description: An Arab army arrives by land and sea at the port of Debal, demanding punishment of pirates who seized their ships and submission from your realm.

ai_indic_konark_sun_temple.title: A Chariot of Stone
ai_indic_konark_sun_temple.description: Your priests propose a vast temple to the Sun at Konark, carved as a stone chariot, to celebrate victories over the sultans of Bengal.

ai_sinic_canton_single_port.title: One Port for Foreigners
ai_sinic_canton_single_port.description: Foreign ships crowd the Pearl River, and the court wants all Western trade confined to this one harbor under licensed merchant houses.

options.label: Grant the Cohong merchants a monopoly
Keep other harbors open to trade

ai_sinic_wokou_coast_raids.title: Pirates on the Coast
ai_sinic_wokou_coast_raids.description: Wokou raiders burn villages along the Zhejiang shore and vanish back to sea before your garrisons can march.

options.label: Recruit and drill hardy miners as soldiers
Ease the sea ban to calm smugglers

ai_sinic_shaanxi_great_earthquake.title: The Earth Splits Open
ai_sinic_shaanxi_great_earthquake.description: A great earthquake has collapsed the cave dwellings of the Wei valley, and countless families lie buried beneath the loess.

options.label: Leave relief to the local gentry

ai_sinic_dragon_bones_inscriptions.title: Writing on Dragon Bones
ai_sinic_dragon_bones_inscriptions.description: Farmers near Anyang sell old bones to apothecaries as medicine, but a scholar has noticed ancient characters carved into them.

options.label: Buy up the bones for scholars

ai_sinic_sichuan_resettlement.title: Empty Fields of Sichuan
ai_sinic_sichuan_resettlement.description: Decades of war have left the Sichuan basin half deserted, and migrants from Huguang ask what they will receive for coming west.

options.label: Grant land and years without tax

ai_sinic_yunnan_copper_mines.title: Copper for the Mints
ai_sinic_yunnan_copper_mines.description: The mints of the capital hunger for Yunnan copper, and the mine bosses want silver advanced before they dig deeper shafts.

options.label: Advance official silver to the mines
Leave the mines to private hands

ai_sinic_shandong_boxer_bands.title: Fists of Righteous Harmony
ai_sinic_shandong_boxer_bands.description: Bands of young boxers in Shandong drill in temple yards and threaten mission churches, while foreign envoys demand you crush them.

ai_sinic_jingzhou_dike_flood.title: The Yangtze Breaks Through
ai_sinic_jingzhou_dike_flood.description: Summer floods have burst the river dikes near Jingzhou and water stands in the city streets.

options.label: Rebuild the dikes with corvee labor
Patch the breaches and cut costs

ai_eastafrica_ibn_battuta_visit.title: A Traveler From Tangier
ai_eastafrica_ibn_battuta_visit.description: The Moroccan traveler Ibn Battuta lands at your port and praises its fine buildings. His account could carry your name across the Muslim world, but his hosts expect lavish gifts.

options.label: Host him with feasts and gifts
Receive him politely, spend nothing more

ai_eastafrica_failing_rains.title: The Rains Fail
ai_eastafrica_failing_rains.description: Years of colder, drier weather have shrunk the harvests in the Limpopo valley. Your people still trade gold and ivory, but granaries are emptying.

options.label: Trade ivory for grain from afar
Ration grain and hold the hill

ai_eastafrica_stone_terraces.title: Stone Channels on the Escarpment
ai_eastafrica_stone_terraces.description: Your farmers want to extend the stone-lined furrows that carry water from the escarpment streams to the terraced fields. The work will take every spare hand for seasons.

options.label: Keep hands free for herding and defense

ai_eastafrica_march_for_salt.title: The Search for Salt
ai_eastafrica_march_for_salt.description: Salt runs short on the plateau, and your advisers speak of the Dande lands to the north. Conquering them would bring salt and tribute, but the old capital would be left behind.

ai_eastafrica_control_of_wells.title: Masters of the Wells
ai_eastafrica_control_of_wells.description: Your governors control the wells and river water of the Shabelle, and herders must pay to water their camels. Some clans now grumble at the tolls.

options.label: Dig new limestone wells for all

ai_eastafrica_great_ditches.title: The Great Earthworks
ai_eastafrica_great_ditches.description: Cattle raiders threaten your grazing lands. Your elders propose cutting deep ditches through the rock around Bigo to enclose the herds and the royal enclosure.

options.label: Dig the ditches deeper and longer
Arm herders to guard the cattle

ai_eastafrica_highland_rice.title: Rice in the Marshes
ai_eastafrica_highland_rice.description: Your settlers in the central highlands could drain the marshes around their hills for rice paddies. The Vazimba who fish and hunt there will resist losing their lands.

options.label: Share the marshes with the Vazimba

ai_eastafrica_beads_at_tsodilo.title: Glass Beads and Shells
ai_eastafrica_beads_at_tsodilo.description: Herders and metalworkers camped near the painted hills offer glass beads, seashells and iron for specularite and hides. Their cattle, though, crowd the springs your people rely on.

options.label: Keep the springs for your bands

ai_indic_drying_rivers.title: The Rivers Run Dry
ai_indic_drying_rivers.description: The Ghaggar-Hakra streams that fed your towns are shrinking each year, and farmers are already drifting east toward the Yamuna and Ganga plains.

options.label: Dig wells and channels to hold them
Lead the families east to new land

ai_americas_sunken_plaza.title: The Sunken Circle
ai_americas_sunken_plaza.description: Your people haul stone in woven shicra bags to raise platform mounds around a round sunken plaza, and the work eats the season.

options.label: Send the haulers to the cotton fields

ai_americas_knotted_cords.title: Knots in Cotton Cord
ai_americas_knotted_cords.description: Your stewards tie knotted cotton cords to keep count of nets and anchovies traded up from the coast, but only a few can read them.

options.label: Train more stewards in the knots

ai_americas_taming_llamas.title: Herds of the Puna
ai_americas_taming_llamas.description: Hunters around the high lake begin penning wild guanaco and vicuña, and some young ones now follow people instead of fleeing.

options.label: Pen and breed the tame herds

ai_americas_lake_copper.title: Copper from the Lakes
ai_americas_lake_copper.description: Traders bring nuggets of pure copper from the northern lakes, soft enough to hammer cold into points and beads.

options.label: Trade copper beads to distant bands

ai_americas_shell_ring.title: The Shell Ring
ai_americas_shell_ring.description: Years of feasting on oysters and whelks have piled shell around your village, and the elders want to shape it into a great ring.

options.label: Raise the ring as a high wall
Hold a great feast for neighbors

ai_americas_small_tool_bands.title: Eastward Across the Ice
ai_americas_small_tool_bands.description: Small bands with fine stone blades and bows push east from the far west, hunting musk ox and seal along the frozen coasts.

options.label: Winter at the known seal grounds

ai_americas_teosinte_gardens.title: The Little Ears
ai_americas_teosinte_gardens.description: In the valley caves, families tend squash and a wild grass whose tiny ears grow a little larger each year they replant the best seed.

ai_americas_river_pottery.title: Fired Clay by the River
ai_americas_river_pottery.description: Shellfish gatherers along the great river learn to temper clay with crushed shell and fire it into pots, but pots tie families to one shore.

options.label: Build kilns at the shell mound
Stay light and follow the floods

ai_sinic_banpo_village_ditch.title: The Ditch Around Banpo
ai_sinic_banpo_village_ditch.description: Your millet farmers on the Wei River live in round pit houses. The elders want a deep ditch dug around the whole village, but the work would leave the fields short of hands.

options.label: Dig the ditch around the houses
Keep every hand in the millet fields

ai_sinic_hemudu_stilt_rice.title: Rice in the Marshes
ai_sinic_hemudu_stilt_rice.description: In the wet lowlands south of the bay, your people raise houses on wooden stilts and plant rice in the mud. Clearing more marsh means felling the forests that feed the hunters.

options.label: Clear the marsh for new paddies
Keep the forest for deer and acorns

ai_sinic_liangzhu_jade_cong.title: The Jade Cong
ai_sinic_liangzhu_jade_cong.description: Your craftsmen grind square jade tubes carved with masked faces, and the great families are buried with them. The carvers ask for more workers and more stone from distant hills.

options.label: Send the workers to build dams

ai_sinic_eggshell_pottery.title: Eggshell Black Pottery
ai_sinic_eggshell_pottery.description: Your potters on the fast wheel now throw black cups as thin as eggshell. The chiefs want them only for feasts and burials, while traders would carry them far along the coast.

options.label: Reserve the cups for the chiefs
Let the traders carry them away
Teach the craft to more apprentices

ai_sinic_shijiahe_earthen_walls.title: Walls of Rammed Earth
ai_sinic_shijiahe_earthen_walls.description: The towns of the middle Yangzi raise great earthen walls and moats around their rice fields. Your neighbors are building theirs, and your people ask whether you will match them.

options.label: Raise a wall of rammed earth
Seek alliance with the walled towns

ai_sinic_chengdu_plain_floods.title: Floods on the Plain
ai_sinic_chengdu_plain_floods.description: Rivers pouring from the western mountains flood the Chengdu plain each summer. Your people can bank the villages with earth or move to higher ground and leave the rich soil.

options.label: Bank the villages with earthen walls
Move the people to higher ground

ai_sinic_northern_jade_traders.title: Strangers Bearing Jade
